verses.text: Blessed is the person who doesn’t follow the advice of the wicked, stand on the road sinners take, or sit down with people who scoff.
Instead, they find joy in the LORD’s law. They keep turning it over in their mind, day and night.
They’re like a tree planted beside streams of water. It bears fruit in season, and its leaves never wither. Whatever they do prospers.
The wicked aren’t like that. They’re like chaff the wind blows away.
So the wicked won’t stand when judgment comes, and sinners won’t stand in the gathering of the righteous.
The LORD knows the road the righteous take, but the road of the wicked leads to ruin.
Why are the nations raging? Why are the peoples cooking up plans that’ll go nowhere?
The kings of the earth take their stand, and the rulers plot together against the LORD and his Anointed. They say,
“Let’s snap their chains and throw their ropes off us.”
The one sitting in heaven laughs. The Lord makes fun of them.
Then he speaks to them in anger, and his wrath terrifies them:
“But I’ve set my King on Zion, my holy hill.”
I’ll tell you what the LORD decreed. He said to me, “You’re my son. Today I’ve become your father.
Ask me, and I’ll give you the nations as your inheritance, the farthest ends of the earth as your own.
You’ll break them with an iron rod. You’ll smash them to pieces like a clay pot.”
So wise up, you kings. Take the warning, you judges of the earth.
Serve the LORD with reverence, and rejoice with trembling.
Pay sincere respect to the Son, or he’ll get angry and you’ll perish on the road, because his anger can flare up quickly. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.
A psalm by David, written when he fled from his son Absalom. LORD, my enemies keep multiplying! So many people are rising up against me.
So many say about me, “God won’t help him.” Selah.
But you, LORD, are a shield all around me. You’re my glory, the one who lifts my head.
I cry out loud to the LORD, and he answers me from his holy hill. Selah.
I lay down and slept. I woke up because the LORD keeps me going.
I won’t be afraid of tens of thousands of people who’ve lined up against me on every side.
Get up, LORD! Save me, my God! You’ve struck all my enemies on the cheekbone. You’ve broken the teeth of the wicked.
Rescue belongs to the LORD. May your blessing rest on your people. Selah.
For the chief musician, on stringed instruments. A psalm by David. Answer when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me room to breathe in my distress. Have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
How long will you people turn my honor into shame? Will you keep loving what’s empty and chasing lies? Selah.
Know this: the LORD has set apart those who are faithful to him. The LORD will hear when I call to him.
Stand in awe and don’t sin. When you’re lying in bed, look into your own heart and be still. Selah.
Offer sacrifices that are right and put your trust in the LORD.
Many people ask, “Who’s going to show us anything good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.
You’ve put more joy in my heart than they have when their grain and new wine overflow.
I’ll lie down and go to sleep in peace. You alone, LORD, let me live in safety.
For the chief musician, with flutes. A psalm by David. LORD, listen to my words. Pay attention to what I’m thinking deep down.
Hear me crying out, my King and my God. You’re the one I pray to.
LORD, you’ll hear my voice in the morning. I’ll lay my requests before you first thing and watch for your answer.
You’re a God who takes no pleasure in wrongdoing. Evil can’t make its home with you.
The arrogant can’t stand in your sight. You hate all who do wrong.
You’ll destroy those who tell lies. The LORD detests anyone who’s out for blood or deals in deceit.
But because your faithful love is so great, I’ll come into your house. I’ll bow toward your holy temple in reverence for you.
LORD, lead me in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight in front of me.
There’s nothing trustworthy in what they say. Their hearts are set on destruction. Their throats are open graves, and their tongues are full of flattery.
Hold them guilty, God. Let their own schemes bring them down. Drive them out for all the wrong they’ve done, because they’ve rebelled against you.
Let everyone who takes refuge in you celebrate. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let those who love your name find joy in you.
You bless the righteous, LORD. You surround them with your favor like a shield.
For the chief musician, on stringed instruments, on the eight-stringed lyre. A psalm by David. LORD, don’t correct me in anger or discipline me in your wrath.
Have mercy on me, LORD. I’m worn out. Heal me, LORD, because my bones are shaking.
Deep down I’m in agony. But you, LORD, how long?
Come back, LORD. Rescue me and save me because of your faithful love.
In death no one remembers you. Who’s going to thank you in Sheol?
I’m exhausted from groaning. Night after night I flood my bed and soak my couch with tears.
My eyes are wearing out from grief. They’ve grown old because of all my enemies.
Get away from me, all you who do wrong. The LORD has heard me crying.
The LORD has heard my plea. The LORD accepts my prayer.
May all my enemies be ashamed and shaken. They’ll turn back and be put to shame in an instant.
A meditation David sang to the LORD about the words of Cush the Benjaminite. LORD my God, I take shelter in you. Save me from everyone chasing me. Get me out of their hands,
or they’ll tear me apart like a lion, ripping me to pieces with no one there to rescue me.
LORD my God, if I really did this, if these hands are guilty,
if I paid back someone who was at peace with me by doing evil, if I plundered someone who was my enemy for no reason,
then let the enemy chase me down and catch me. Let him trample my life into the ground and lay my honor in the dust. Selah.
Rise up in your anger, LORD. Stand against the fury of my enemies. Wake up for me. You’ve called for judgment.
Let the peoples gather around you. Rule over them from on high.
The LORD judges the peoples. Judge me, LORD, by my righteousness and the integrity within me.
Put an end to the evil of the wicked and make the righteous stand firm. You’re the righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
God is my shield. He saves those whose hearts are upright.
God is a righteous judge, a God who feels indignation every day.
If a person refuses to turn back, God will sharpen his sword. He’s bent his bow and set the string.
He’s prepared his weapons of death and made his flaming arrows ready.
Look, the wicked person is in labor with wrongdoing. They conceived trouble and gave birth to lies.
They dug a hole, then fell into the very pit they made.
The trouble they cause will come back on their own head. Their violence will come down on the crown of their own head.
I’ll thank the LORD for his righteousness. I’ll sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
For the chief musician, on an instrument from Gath. A psalm by David. LORD, our Lord, your name is majestic across the whole earth! You’ve set your glory above the heavens.
From the mouths of babies and infants you’ve established strength against your enemies, to silence the enemy and the one out for revenge.
When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and stars you put in place,
what are human beings that you’d think of them? What is a child of humanity that you’d care for them?
You made them a little lower than the angels and crowned them with glory and honor.
You put them in charge of what your hands made. You placed everything under their feet:
all sheep and cattle, and the animals out in the fields,
the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and everything that travels the paths of the seas.
LORD, our Lord, your name is majestic across the whole earth!
For the chief musician, set to “The Death of the Son.” A psalm by David. I’ll thank the LORD with my whole heart. I’ll tell about all the wonders you’ve done.
I’ll be glad and celebrate in you. I’ll sing praise to your name, Most High.
When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
You’ve upheld my just cause. You sit on your throne and judge rightly.
You’ve rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked. You’ve erased their name forever and ever.
The enemy has fallen into ruin that won’t end. Even the memory of the cities you tore down is gone.
But the LORD reigns forever. He’s set up his throne for judgment.
He’ll judge the world with righteousness and give each people a fair judgment.
The LORD will be a high tower for the oppressed, a high tower in times of trouble.
Those who know your name will trust you, LORD, because you haven’t abandoned anyone who seeks you.
Sing praise to the LORD who lives in Zion. Tell the peoples what he’s done.
The one who avenges blood remembers them. He never forgets the cry of those who suffer.
Have mercy on me, LORD. See what I’m suffering at the hands of those who hate me. Lift me up from the gates of death,
so I can tell everyone why you deserve praise. At the gates of the daughter of Zion, I’ll celebrate the way you saved me.
The nations have sunk into the pit they dug. Their own feet got caught in the net they hid.
The LORD has made himself known by carrying out judgment. The wicked get caught by what their own hands have done. Meditation. Selah.
The wicked will be turned back to Sheol, along with every nation that forgets God.
The needy won’t always be forgotten, and the hope of the poor won’t be lost forever.
Rise up, LORD! Don’t let mere mortals win. Bring the nations to judgment before you.
Put fear in them, LORD. Let the nations know they’re only human. Selah.
Why do you stand so far away, LORD? Why do you hide when trouble hits?
The wicked are arrogant and hunt down the weak. They get caught in the very schemes they come up with.
The wicked brag about what their hearts crave. They bless the greedy and condemn the LORD.
They hold their heads high in pride, with no room for God in their thoughts.
Everything keeps going their way. They’re arrogant, and your laws are far from their sight. They sneer at every enemy.
Deep down they say, “Nothing can shake me. Trouble won’t touch me for generations.”
Their mouths are full of curses, lies, and oppression. Under their tongues are trouble and wrongdoing.
They lie in wait near the villages and murder innocent people from hiding. Their eyes secretly watch for the helpless.
They lurk like a lion in its hiding place, waiting to catch the helpless. They catch them by drawing them into their net.
The helpless are crushed. They collapse and fall under the weight of that strength.
Deep down the wicked say, “God forgot. He hides his face. He’ll never see it.”
Rise up, LORD! God, lift your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
Why do the wicked condemn God and tell themselves, “God won’t call me to account”?
But you do see trouble and grief. You take notice and take it into your own hands. You help the victim and the fatherless.
Break the arm of the wicked. Search out the evildoer’s wickedness till there’s none left to find.
The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will vanish from his land.
LORD, you’ve heard what the humble long for. You’ll steady their hearts and listen to them,
to give justice to the fatherless and oppressed, so no mere mortal can terrorize them anymore.
For the chief musician. By David. I take refuge in the LORD. How can you tell me, “Fly off to your mountain like a bird”?
Look, the wicked are bending their bows. They’ve set arrows on the strings to shoot from the dark at people whose hearts are upright.
If the foundations are torn down, what can the righteous do?
The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes watch what’s happening and examine every person.
The LORD examines the righteous, but deep down he hates the wicked and anyone who loves violence.
He’ll rain burning coals on the wicked. Fire, sulfur, and scorching wind will be their share to drink.
The LORD is righteous and loves what’s right. The upright will see his face.
For the chief musician, on an eight-stringed lyre. A psalm by David. Help, LORD! Godly people are disappearing. The faithful are vanishing from among us.
Everyone lies to their neighbor. They flatter with their lips and say one thing while meaning another.
May the LORD cut off every flattering lip and every tongue that brags,
the ones who say, “We’ll win with our words. Our lips are ours. Who’s our lord?”
“The weak are being crushed, and the needy are groaning, so now I’ll rise up,” says the LORD. “I’ll give them safety from the people who speak against them.”
The LORD’s words are flawless, like silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
You’ll keep them safe, LORD. You’ll protect them from this generation forever.
The wicked walk around on every side when people lift up what’s vile.
For the music director. A psalm by David. How long, LORD? Are you going to forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long do I have to wrestle with my thoughts and carry this grief every day? How long will my enemy keep getting the upper hand?
Look at me and answer, LORD my God. Give light to my eyes so I don't fall into the sleep of death.
Don't let my enemy say, “I beat him,” or let the people against me celebrate when I fall.
But I'm trusting your faithful love. My heart celebrates because you save me.
I'll sing to the LORD because he's been good to me. 🎶
For the music director. By David. The fool thinks, “There's no God.” They've become corrupt and done awful things. No one does good.
The LORD looked down from heaven at humanity to see if anyone understood and was looking for God.
They've all turned away and become corrupt together. No one does good. Not even one.
Do these people doing wrong really get nothing? They devour my people like they're eating bread, and they never call on the LORD.
They were terrified there, because God is with those who do what's right.
You try to wreck the plans of the poor, because the LORD is their safe place.
If only rescue for Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores what his people have lost, Jacob will celebrate and Israel will be glad. 🙌
A psalm by David. LORD, who gets to stay in your sanctuary? Who can live on your holy hill?
Someone who lives with integrity, does what's right, and speaks the truth from the heart.
They don't drag people with their words, hurt their friends, or throw insults at their neighbors.
They reject people who do vile things and honor those who revere the LORD. They keep their word even when it costs them.
They don't lend money to squeeze people for interest or take a bribe against someone innocent. Live like that and you won't be shaken.
A poem by David. Keep me safe, God. You're where I go for shelter.
My soul, you've told the LORD, “You're my Lord. Without you, I have nothing good.”
The faithful on earth are the people I respect and love to be around.
People who bring gifts to another god pile up grief. I won't pour out their offerings of blood or even say the names of their gods.
The LORD has given me my share and my cup. You keep what you've given me secure.
My boundary lines landed in good places. I've been given a beautiful inheritance.
I'll bless the LORD for guiding me. Even at night my heart teaches me.
I keep the LORD in front of me always. With him at my right hand, I won't be shaken.
So my heart is glad, and I can't stop celebrating. My body can rest safely too.
You won't leave my soul in Sheol or let your holy one decay.
You'll show me the path of life. With you, joy is full. At your right hand there's delight forever. 🙌
A prayer by David. Hear my just plea, LORD. Listen to my prayer. I'm speaking honestly.
Let the verdict come from you. Look at what's fair.
You've examined my heart and checked on me at night. You've tested me and found nothing. I've made up my mind to keep my words in line.
Whatever others do, your words have kept me off the path of violent people.
I've stayed on your paths. My feet haven't slipped.
I'm calling on you because you'll answer me, God. Lean in and hear what I'm saying.
Show me your incredible faithful love. With your right hand you rescue people who run to you for shelter from their enemies.
Guard me like the pupil of your eye. Hide me in the shadow of your wings,
away from the wicked who oppress me, from deadly enemies who have me surrounded.
Their hearts are closed off, and they talk like they're better than everyone.
They've surrounded us wherever we step. They're watching for a chance to throw us to the ground.
He's like a lion hungry for prey, a young lion hiding in wait.
Get up, LORD. Face him and bring him down. Use your sword to rescue me from the wicked.
Save me by your hand, LORD, from people of this world whose share is in this life. You fill the bellies of those you cherish. Their children have plenty and put some aside for their own kids.
As for me, I'll see your face in righteousness. When I wake up, seeing you will be enough.
For the music director. By David, the LORD's servant. David sang this to the LORD when the LORD rescued him from all his enemies and from Saul. He said, “I love you, LORD. You're my strength.”
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my rescuer. My God is the rock I run to for shelter, my shield, the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
I call on the LORD, who deserves praise, and he saves me from my enemies.
Death's ropes wrapped around me. Floods of lawlessness terrified me.
The ropes of Sheol closed in around me. Death's traps sprang on me.
In my distress I called on the LORD and cried to my God. From his temple he heard my voice. My cry reached his ears.
Then the earth shook hard. Even the foundations of the mountains trembled because he was angry.
Smoke rose from his nostrils. Fire poured from his mouth, devouring everything and setting coals ablaze.
He bent the heavens down and descended. Thick darkness was under his feet.
He rode a cherub and flew, soaring on the wings of the wind.
He hid himself in darkness, surrounded by a canopy of dark waters and thick storm clouds.
At the brightness before him, his thick clouds swept by with hailstones and burning coals.
The LORD thundered in the sky. The Most High raised his voice amid hailstones and burning coals.
He fired his arrows and scattered them. With huge lightning bolts he sent them running.
The channels of the waters came into view, and the world's foundations lay exposed when you rebuked them, LORD, at the blast from your nostrils.
He reached down from on high, took hold of me, and pulled me out of deep waters.
He rescued me from my powerful enemy and from those who hated me. They were too strong for me.
They came at me on the day everything fell apart, but the LORD held me up.
He led me out into wide-open space. He rescued me because he delighted in me.
The LORD rewarded me for doing what's right. He repaid me because my hands were clean.
I've stayed on the LORD's paths and haven't turned away from my God to do wrong.
I've kept all his rulings in front of me. I haven't pushed his instructions aside.
I've lived with integrity before him and kept myself from sin.
So the LORD rewarded me for doing what's right, because he saw that my hands were clean.
You show mercy to the merciful and deal with integrity toward people of integrity.
You show yourself pure to the pure, and you outmaneuver the crooked.
You save people who are suffering and bring down those who look at others with arrogance.
You light my lamp, LORD. My God lights up my darkness. 🕯️
With you I can charge through a troop. With my God I can clear a wall.
God's way is flawless. The LORD's word holds up under testing. He's a shield for everyone who runs to him for shelter.
Who is God besides the LORD? Who's a rock besides our God,
the God who gives me strength and makes my way sound?
He makes me sure-footed like a deer and sets me up on the heights.
He trains my hands for battle so my arms can bend a bronze bow.
You gave me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand holds me up. Your gentleness made me great.
You gave me room to stride, and my feet haven't slipped.
I'll chase down my enemies and catch them. I won't turn back until they're wiped out.
I'll strike them down so they can't get back up. They'll fall beneath my feet.
You gave me strength for battle and brought down those who rose against me.
You made my enemies turn and run from me so I could cut off those who hate me.
They cried for help, but nobody saved them. They even cried to the LORD, but he didn't answer.
I crushed them fine as dust in the wind. I threw them out like mud in the streets.
You rescued me from the people's conflicts and made me head of the nations. People I haven't even met will serve me.
The moment they hear of me, they'll obey. People from other lands will submit to me.
Their courage will fade, and they'll come trembling out of their strongholds.
The LORD lives! Praise my rock! Lift up the God who saves me, 🙌
the God who brings justice for me and brings peoples under my rule.
He rescues me from my enemies. You lift me above those who rise against me and save me from violent people.
That's why I'll thank you, LORD, among the nations and sing praises to your name.
He gives his king great victories and shows faithful love to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
For the music director. A psalm by David. The heavens tell of God's glory. The wide-open sky shows what his hands made.
Day after day they have something to say. Night after night they share what they know.
There's no speech or language where their voice goes unheard.
Their voice reaches across the whole earth, their words to the ends of the world. God pitched a tent in the heavens for the sun,
which steps out like a groom leaving his room, like a champion hyped to run his course.
It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its way to the other. Nothing escapes its heat. ☀️
The LORD's law is flawless and brings the soul back to life. His covenant is trustworthy and gives wisdom to the inexperienced.
The LORD's instructions are right and make the heart glad. His command is pure and gives light to the eyes.
Reverence for the LORD is clean and lasts forever. His rulings are true and right through and through.
They're worth wanting more than gold, even piles of pure gold. They're sweeter than honey dripping from the comb.
Through them you warn your servant. There's a great reward in living by them.
Who can spot all their own mistakes? Forgive me for the ones I can't see.
Keep your servant from sins I commit on purpose. Don't let them run my life. Then I'll live with integrity and be clear of serious wrongdoing.
May what I say and what I dwell on in my heart please you, LORD, my rock and my redeemer.
For the music director. A psalm by David. May the LORD answer you when trouble hits. May the name of Jacob's God lift you to safety,
send help from his sanctuary, and back you up from Zion.
May he remember everything you've offered and accept your burnt sacrifice. Selah.
May he give you what your heart longs for and bring all your plans to life.
We'll cheer when he rescues you and raise our banners in the name of our God. May the LORD grant every request you make. 🙌
Now I know the LORD saves his anointed. He'll answer him from his holy heaven with the saving power of his right hand.
Some put their trust in chariots, others in horses. We trust in the name of the LORD our God.
They buckle and fall, but we rise and stand tall.
Save us, LORD! May the King answer when we call!
For the music director. A psalm by David. LORD, the king celebrates your strength! He's overjoyed because you saved him.
You gave him what his heart wanted. You didn't hold back what he asked for. Selah.
You came to meet him with good blessings and put a crown of pure gold on his head. 👑
He asked you for life, and you gave it to him, days that stretch on forever and ever.
Your rescue brought him great glory. You gave him honor and majesty.
You bless him forever and fill him with joy in your presence.
The king trusts in the LORD. The faithful love of the Most High keeps him steady.
Your hand will find every enemy. Your right hand will find everyone who hates you.
When your anger flares, you'll make them like a blazing furnace. The LORD will swallow them up in his anger. Fire will consume them.
You'll wipe their descendants off the earth and their family line from humanity.
They meant to hurt you. They came up with a scheme that can't work.
You'll send them running when you aim your drawn bows right at them.
Rise high in your strength, LORD! We'll sing and praise your power. 🎶
For the music director, to “The Doe of the Morning.” A psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you left me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from hearing me groan?
My God, I cry out all day and get no answer. At night I still can't keep quiet.
But you are holy, enthroned in Israel's praises.
Our ancestors trusted you. They put their trust in you, and you rescued them.
They cried to you and got free. They trusted you, and you didn't let them down.
I feel like a worm, barely human. People look down on me and treat me like a disgrace.
Everyone who sees me makes fun of me. They sneer and shake their heads.
“He trusts the LORD? Let the LORD save him. Let him come rescue him if he's so pleased with him.”
But you brought me out of the womb. You taught me to trust you while I was still nursing.
I've been in your care since birth. You've been my God since my mother had me.
Stay close. Trouble is right here, and nobody's coming to help.
Bulls are all around me. Powerful bulls from Bashan have closed in.
They open their mouths wide at me like roaring lions tearing into prey.
I'm poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart melts inside me like wax.
My strength is dried up like a broken clay pot. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You've brought me down to the dust of death.
Dogs have surrounded me. A gang of evildoers has boxed me in. They've pierced my hands and feet.
I can count every bone. They just look and stare.
They split up my clothes and cast lots to see who gets them.
LORD, please stay close. You're my help. Come quick!
Rescue me from the sword. Save the one life I have from the dog's power.
Save me from the lion's mouth! Yes, you've rescued me from the horns of wild oxen.
I'll tell my brothers your name. I'll praise you right there in the gathering.
Everyone who reveres the LORD, praise him! All Jacob's descendants, give him glory! All Israel's descendants, stand in awe of him! 🙌
He never looked down on the suffering of the one in pain or turned away in disgust. He didn't hide his face. When that person cried for help, he heard.
My praise for you will ring out in the great gathering. I'll keep my vows in front of those who revere you.
The humble will eat their fill. Everyone who seeks the LORD will praise him. May your hearts live forever.
The whole earth, right to its farthest ends, will remember and turn to the LORD. Every family of every nation will worship before you.
The kingdom belongs to the LORD. He rules over the nations.
The rich of the earth will eat and worship. Everyone going down to the dust will bow before him, even those who can't keep themselves alive.
Their descendants will serve him. Generations to come will hear about the Lord.
They'll go and tell people who haven't even been born about his righteousness, because he's done it.
A psalm by David. The LORD is my shepherd. I have everything I need.
He has me rest in green pastures and leads me beside quiet waters.
He restores my soul and guides me down the right paths for the sake of his name.
Even when I walk through the valley of death's shadow, I won't fear any evil. You're with me. Your rod and your staff give me comfort.
You set a table for me with my enemies watching. You anoint my head with oil. My cup is overflowing.
Your goodness and faithful love will follow me every day of my life. I'll live in the LORD's house forever. 🙏
A psalm by David. The earth belongs to the LORD, along with everything in it. The whole world and everyone living here are his.
He laid its foundations on the seas and set it firmly over the waters.
Who can go up the LORD's hill? Who can stand in his holy place?
People with clean hands and pure hearts who don't give themselves over to lies or swear an oath to deceive.
They'll receive a blessing from the LORD and righteousness from the God who saves them.
This is the generation that seeks him, Jacob's people who seek your face. Selah.
Heads up, you gates! Rise up, ancient doors! The King of glory is coming in. 👑
Who's this King of glory? The LORD, strong and mighty. The LORD, mighty in battle.
Lift your heads, you gates! Rise up, ancient doors! The King of glory is coming in.
Who's this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
By David. LORD, I lift my soul to you.
My God, I'm trusting you. Don't let me be humiliated or let my enemies win over me.
Nobody who waits for you will be put to shame. Shame will fall on those who betray others for no reason.
Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.
Lead me in your truth and teach me. You're the God who saves me, and I wait for you all day.
LORD, remember your tender mercy and faithful love. They've been there since long ago.
Don't hold the sins of my youth or my wrongs against me. Remember me with faithful love, because you are good, LORD.
The LORD is good and upright, so he shows sinners the way.
He guides humble people in what's just and teaches them how to walk in his ways.
Every path of the LORD is marked by faithful love and truth for people who keep his covenant and follow his instructions.
For the sake of your name, LORD, forgive my sin. It's a big one.
Whoever reveres the LORD, he'll teach them which way to choose.
They'll live at ease, and their children will inherit the land.
The LORD shares his friendship with people who revere him. He makes his covenant known to them.
My eyes stay on the LORD. He'll pull my feet free from the net.
Turn toward me and give me mercy. I'm alone and hurting.
The trouble in my heart keeps growing. Please get me out of this pain.
See how I'm hurting and struggling. Forgive all my sins.
Look at how many enemies I have. The way they hate me is cruel.
Guard my life and rescue me. Don't let me down, because I run to you for shelter.
Let integrity and doing what's right keep me safe as I wait for you.
God, redeem Israel from all its troubles. 🙏
By David. Judge me, LORD. I've lived with integrity and trusted you without wavering.
Look me over, LORD, and put me to the test. Search my heart and my mind.
Your faithful love is right in front of me, and I've walked in your truth.
I haven't sat with people who lie, and I'm not joining up with hypocrites.
I hate the gatherings of people doing evil. I won't sit with the wicked.
I'll wash my hands in innocence and go around your altar, LORD,
so everyone can hear me give thanks and tell of all the amazing things you've done.
LORD, I love the house where you live, the place where your glory stays.
Don't sweep my life away with sinners or count me among people out for blood.
Their hands are full of wrongdoing, and their right hands are full of bribes.
As for me, I'll keep walking with integrity. Redeem me and show me mercy.
My feet are on level ground. I'll bless the LORD when the people gather. 🙌
By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Who should I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Who could scare me?
When people came at me like they wanted to eat me alive, my enemies were the ones who stumbled and fell.
Even if an army camps around me, my heart won't be afraid. Even if war breaks out against me, I'll stay confident.
One thing I've asked of the LORD, and I'll keep seeking it: to live in his house every day of my life, to see his beauty and seek him in his temple.
When trouble hits, he'll shelter me in his pavilion. He'll hide me in the safest part of his tent and set me high on a rock.
Then I'll hold my head high above the enemies around me. I'll bring joyful sacrifices to his tent and sing my praises to the LORD. 🎶
LORD, hear me when I call out. Show me mercy and answer me.
You said, “Seek my face.” My heart answered, “LORD, I'll seek your face.”
Please don't hide your face or turn your servant away in anger. You've been my help. Don't leave me or give up on me, God who saves me.
Even if my father and mother leave me, the LORD will take me in.
Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me on a straight path with my enemies watching.
Don't hand me over to what my enemies want. People have stood up to lie about me, and they're breathing threats.
I'm still sure I'll see the LORD's goodness in the land of the living.
Wait for the LORD. Stay strong and take heart. Yes, wait for the LORD.
By David. LORD, I'm calling to you. You're my rock. Please don't go quiet on me, or I'll be like the people going down into the pit.
Hear me pleading when I cry out to you and lift my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
Don't drag me away with the wicked, with people who talk peace to their neighbors while plotting harm in their hearts.
Pay them back for what they've done and for how wickedly they've acted. Give them back what their own hands have earned.
They pay no attention to the LORD's works or to what his hands have made. He'll tear them down and won't build them back up.
Bless the LORD! He heard me pleading for help.
The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart trusted him, and he came through for me. My heart is full of joy, and I'll thank him with a song. 🎶
The LORD is his people's strength, a fortress of safety for his anointed.
Save your people and bless those who belong to you. Be their shepherd and carry them forever.
A psalm by David. Give the LORD his due, you sons of the mighty. Give the LORD glory and strength.
Give the LORD the glory his name deserves. Worship him in holy splendor.
The LORD's voice rolls over the waters. The God of glory thunders. That's the LORD over the vast waters.
The LORD's voice comes with power. His voice is full of majesty.
The LORD's voice snaps cedars. He shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
He makes the mountains skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.
The LORD's voice strikes in flashes of lightning. ⚡
The LORD's voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
The LORD's voice makes the deer give birth and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything cries, “Glory!”
The LORD sat on his throne at the Flood. The LORD reigns as King forever.
The LORD gives strength to his people. The LORD blesses his people with peace.
A psalm by David. A song for the dedication of the temple. I'll lift you up, LORD, because you lifted me up. You didn't let my enemies celebrate over me.
LORD my God, I cried out to you, and you healed me.
LORD, you pulled me up from Sheol. You kept me alive and out of the pit.
Sing your praise to the LORD, you who are faithful to him. Give thanks to his holy name.
His anger lasts a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime. Tears can stay the night, but joy shows up in the morning. 🌅
When things were going my way, I said, “Nothing's ever going to shake me.”
LORD, your favor made my mountain stand firm. Then you hid your face, and I was shaken.
I cried out to you, LORD. I pleaded with you:
“What good comes of my death if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise you or tell people your truth?
Hear me, LORD, and show me mercy. LORD, come help me.”
You turned my mourning into dancing. You took off my clothes of grief and dressed me in joy, 💃
so my heart can sing your praise and never go quiet. LORD my God, I'll thank you forever!
For the music director. A psalm by David. LORD, I run to you for shelter. Never let me be put to shame. Rescue me in your righteousness.
Lean in and hear me. Rescue me quick. Be my sturdy rock, a fortress where I can be safe.
You're my rock and my fortress. For the sake of your name, lead me and guide me.
Pull me out of the trap they hid for me. You're my stronghold.
I entrust my spirit to your hand. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.
I hate those who put their faith in worthless lies. My trust is in the LORD.
I'll be glad and celebrate your faithful love. You've seen me hurting. You knew what I was going through.
You didn't hand me over to my enemy. You set my feet in wide-open space.
Have mercy on me, LORD. I'm in trouble. Grief wears down my eyes, my soul, and my body.
My life drains away in sorrow and my years in sighs. My wrongdoing saps my strength. My bones are wasting away.
Because of my enemies, even my neighbors look down on me. People I know are horrified. When they see me in the street, they run.
They've forgotten me like someone who's died. I'm like a shattered pot.
I hear all the rumors. There's terror on every side. They've teamed up against me and are plotting to take my life.
But I trust you, LORD. I say, “You're my God.”
My times are in your hand. Rescue me from my enemies and from people coming after me.
Let your face shine on your servant. Save me through your faithful love.
LORD, don't let me be put to shame, because I've called on you. Let the wicked be ashamed and fall silent in Sheol.
Silence those lying lips that talk down to people who do right, full of pride and contempt.
Your goodness is so great! You store it up for those who revere you and show it openly to people who run to you for shelter.
You hide them in your presence, safe from people's schemes. You shelter them away from vicious talk.
Praise the LORD! In a fortified city he showed me how amazing his faithful love is.
I panicked and said, “I'm cut off from your sight.” Still, you heard me pleading when I cried out to you.
Love the LORD, all you faithful ones! He protects those who stay faithful and pays the arrogant back in full.
Stay strong and take heart, all of you who put your hope in the LORD. 🙏
By David. A psalm for reflection. Blessed are those whose rebellion is forgiven and whose sin is covered.
Blessed are those whose wrongdoing the LORD doesn't count against them, who have no deceit in their spirit.
When I kept quiet, my bones wore down as I groaned all day.
Day and night your hand weighed on me. My strength dried up like water in the summer heat. Selah.
I admitted my sin to you. I stopped hiding what I'd done. I said, “I'll confess my rebellion to the LORD,” and you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah.
So let everyone faithful pray to you while you can be found. When mighty waters rise, they won't reach them.
You're my hiding place. You keep me safe from trouble and surround me with songs of rescue. Selah.
I'll teach you the way you should go. I'll give you advice and keep my eye on you.
Don't be like a horse or a mule that doesn't understand. It takes a bit and bridle to steer them, or they won't come near you.
The wicked go through plenty of sorrow, but faithful love surrounds those who trust the LORD.
Be glad in the LORD and celebrate, you who do what's right! Shout for joy, all of you with honest hearts! 🙌
Celebrate in the LORD, you who do what's right! Praise looks good on people who live with integrity.
Thank the LORD with the lyre. Sing to him with the ten-string harp.
Sing him a new song. Play it well and shout for joy! 🎶
The LORD's word is right, and he does everything faithfully.
He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the LORD's faithful love.
The LORD spoke and made the heavens. Every star in their ranks came from the breath of his mouth.
He gathers up the sea like a heap and puts the deep waters in storehouses.
Let the whole earth revere the LORD. Let everyone in the world stand in awe of him.
He spoke, and it happened. He gave the command, and it stood firm.
The LORD shuts down the plans of nations and stops their schemes from going anywhere.
The LORD's plans stand forever. What he intends in his heart lasts through every generation.
Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people he chose as his own inheritance.
The LORD looks down from heaven and sees all humanity.
From where he lives, he looks out over everyone on earth.
He formed each of their hearts, and he takes note of everything they do.
A huge army can't guarantee a king's rescue. All the strength in the world can't save a warrior.
Counting on a horse to keep you safe is a dead end. Even its great strength can't rescue you.
Look, the LORD watches over those who revere him and put their hope in his faithful love.
He rescues them from death and keeps them alive when food runs out.
We wait for the LORD with our whole hearts. He's our help and our shield.
Our hearts celebrate in him because we've put our trust in his holy name.
Let your faithful love rest on us, LORD, because our hope is in you.
By David, when he acted like he'd lost his mind in front of Abimelech, who drove him away, and David left. I'll bless the LORD at all times. I'll always have praise for him on my lips.
My soul boasts in the LORD. Let humble people hear it and be glad.
Celebrate the LORD's greatness with me. Let's lift up his name together! 🙌
I went looking for the LORD, and he answered me. He rescued me from all my fears.
People who look to him light up. Their faces will never be covered in shame.
This poor man cried out, and the LORD heard him and saved him from all his troubles.
The LORD's angel camps around those who revere him and rescues them.
Taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is anyone who runs to him for shelter.
Revere the LORD, you who are faithful to him. Those who revere him have what they need.
Even young lions go hungry, but people who seek the LORD won't lack anything good.
Come here, children, and listen. I'll teach you what it means to revere the LORD.
Who wants to live a long life and see good days?
Keep your tongue away from evil and your lips away from lies.
Turn away from evil and do good. Look for peace and go after it.
The LORD watches over people who do what's right. He listens when they cry out.
The LORD stands against those who do evil, to wipe even their memory from the earth.
When people who do what's right cry out, the LORD hears and rescues them from all their troubles.
The LORD stays close to the brokenhearted and saves people whose spirits are crushed. ❤️‍🩹
People who do what's right go through plenty of hardship, and the LORD rescues them from it all.
He guards all their bones. Not one gets broken.
Evil will kill the wicked. People who hate those who do right will be found guilty.
The LORD redeems the lives of his servants. Everyone who runs to him for shelter will be free from condemnation.
By David. LORD, take my side against those who come after me. Fight against those who fight me.
Grab your shield and buckler and stand up to help me.
Raise your spear and block the people chasing me. Tell my soul, “I'm the one who saves you.”
Let the people trying to take my life come away ashamed and dishonored. Turn back those plotting my ruin and leave them confused.
Make them like chaff in the wind, with the LORD's angel driving them away.
Let their path go dark and slippery, with the LORD's angel chasing them.
For no reason they hid a net for me in a pit. For no reason they dug a pit to take my life.
Let ruin catch him off guard. Let the net he hid catch him instead. Let him fall into his own trap.
My soul will celebrate in the LORD and take joy in how he saved me.
Every bone in my body will say, “LORD, who's like you? You rescue the poor from someone too strong for them, and the poor and needy from people who rob them.”
False witnesses stand up and question me about things I know nothing about.
I did good for them, and they paid me back with evil. It left my soul grieving.
When they were sick, I wore sackcloth. I humbled myself by fasting, and my prayer came back to my own heart.
I treated them as friends or brothers. I bowed down grieving like someone mourning their own mother.
But when I was in trouble, they celebrated and gathered against me. The attackers came together without me knowing. They tore into me and wouldn't stop.
Like people at a feast mocking what is sacred, they gnashed their teeth at me.
Lord, how long will you watch this happen? Save me from the ruin they have planned. Rescue my precious life from the lions.
I'll thank you in the great gathering. I'll praise you in front of all those people.
Don't let people who are my enemies without cause celebrate over me. Don't let people who hate me for no reason wink at each other.
They don't speak peace. They make up lies about people who live quietly in the land.
They open their mouths wide against me and go, “Aha! Aha! We saw it ourselves!”
You've seen it, LORD. Don't stay silent. Lord, stay close to me.
Wake up! Get up and defend me, my God! My Lord, take up my case!
Show that I'm in the right, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don't let them gloat over me.
Don't let them think, “Yes! That's exactly what we wanted!” Don't let them say, “We swallowed him up!”
Let everyone who celebrates my trouble end up ashamed and confused. Let the people who talk big against me be dressed in shame and dishonor.
Let everyone who backs my just cause shout with joy. Let them keep saying, “Praise the greatness of the LORD, who delights in seeing his servant thrive!” 🙌
I'll talk about your righteousness and sing your praise all day long.
For the music director. By David, the LORD's servant. Something became clear to me about the rebellion of the wicked: they have no fear of God before their eyes.
They hype themselves up so much that they can't even see their own sin or hate it.
Their words are full of wrongdoing and lies. They've given up on wisdom and on doing good.
They lie in bed plotting wrong. They commit to a path that leads nowhere good. Evil doesn't even bother them.
LORD, your faithful love reaches the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches the skies.
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are as deep as the ocean. LORD, you keep people and animals alive.
God, how precious is your faithful love! People take shelter in the shadow of your wings.
They feast on the abundance of your house. You give them a drink from the river of your delights.
The spring of life is with you. In your light, we see light. ✨
Keep showing your faithful love to those who know you, and your righteousness to people with upright hearts.
Don't let the proud come and trample me. Don't let the wicked drive me away.
Look, the people doing evil have fallen. They've been thrown down and won't get back up.
By David. Don't stress over people doing evil or envy people who do wrong.
Soon they'll be cut down like grass and dry up like green plants.
Trust the LORD and do good. Live in the land and enjoy safe pasture.
Find your joy in the LORD, and he'll give you what your heart desires.
Put your life in the LORD's hands. Trust him, and he'll act.
He'll make your righteousness shine like daylight and your justice like the noon sun. ☀️
Rest in the LORD and wait patiently for him. Don't stress over people getting ahead by making wicked schemes work.
Let go of anger and drop the rage. Don't let worry eat at you. It only leads to doing wrong.
People who do evil will be cut off. Those who wait for the LORD will inherit the land.
Give it a little time and the wicked will be gone. You'll look where they used to be and find nobody there.
The humble will inherit the land and enjoy peace in abundance.
The wicked plot against people who do right and gnash their teeth at them.
The Lord laughs at them because he sees their day coming.
The wicked draw swords and bend their bows to bring down the poor and needy and kill people who walk with integrity.
Their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will snap.
The little that righteous people have is better than the piles of wealth the wicked have.
The strength of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD holds up those who do right.
The LORD knows the days of people who live with integrity. Their inheritance lasts forever.
Hard times won't leave them ashamed. When famine hits, they'll have enough.
The wicked will perish. The LORD's enemies will fade like the beauty of the fields and vanish like smoke.
The wicked borrow and never pay it back. People who do right give freely.
Those the LORD blesses will inherit the land. Those he curses will be cut off.
The LORD steadies a person's steps and takes delight in their way.
Even if they stumble, they won't fall flat, because the LORD holds them up by the hand.
I was young once and now I'm old. I've never seen people who do right abandoned or their children begging for bread.
They're generous all day long and lend to others. Their children are blessed.
Turn away from evil and do good. You'll live securely forever.
The LORD loves justice and stays with his faithful people. He keeps them safe forever, but the children of the wicked will be cut off.
People who do right will inherit the land and live there forever.
People who do right speak wisdom and talk about what's just.
They keep God's law in their hearts. Their feet won't slip.
The wicked watch people who do right, looking for a chance to kill them.
The LORD won't leave his faithful people in their grip or condemn them when they stand trial.
Wait for the LORD and stay on his path. He'll lift you up to inherit the land, and you'll see the wicked cut off.
I've seen wicked people with serious power, spreading like a thriving tree in its native soil.
Then they passed away, and suddenly they were gone. I looked for them and couldn't find them.
Pay attention to people who live with integrity. Watch those who do right. People who make peace have a future.
People who rebel will be destroyed together. The future of the wicked will be cut off.
The LORD saves people who do right. He's their stronghold when trouble hits.
The LORD helps them and pulls them out of danger. He rescues them from the wicked because they've taken shelter in him. 🙏
A psalm by David, for remembrance. LORD, please don't rebuke me in your wrath or discipline me in your burning anger.
Your arrows have pierced me. Your hand is pressing hard on me.
Your anger has left my body sick, and my sin has left my bones without strength.
My wrongs are over my head. They're a load I can't carry.
My wounds stink and fester because of my foolish choices.
I'm doubled over in pain. I go around mourning all day.
My lower back burns, and my whole body feels sick.
I'm weak and badly bruised. I groan because my heart is in anguish.
Lord, you see everything I long for. You can hear every groan.
My heart pounds, my strength gives out, and even the light in my eyes is gone.
The people I love and my friends stay away because of what's happened to me. Even my family keeps its distance.
People who want me dead set traps. People who want to hurt me talk about how to do it and plot lies all day.
But I act like I didn't hear them. I keep my mouth closed and say nothing.
I'm like someone who hears nothing and has no answer to give.
My hope is in you, LORD. You'll answer me, Lord my God. 🙏
I said, “Don't let them gloat over me or act like they've won when I slip.”
I'm about to fall. The pain never lets up.
I'll own up to what I've done wrong. I'm sorry for my sin.
My enemies are strong, and there are lots of them. So many people hate me for no reason.
People who pay back good with evil turn against me because I keep going after what's good.
Don't leave me, LORD. My God, please stay close.
Come help me quick, Lord, my salvation.
For the music director. For Jeduthun. A psalm by David. I said, “I'll watch how I act so I don't sin with my words. I'll keep my mouth on a tight leash while the wicked are in front of me.”
I went completely quiet. I held back even good words, and my grief grew.
My heart burned inside me. The more I thought, the hotter it got, until I finally spoke:
“LORD, show me where my life ends and how many days I have. Let me see how fragile I am.
You've made my days only a few handbreadths long. My whole life is like nothing next to you. Even when we stand firm, we're just a breath.” Selah.
“People go around like shadows, rushing for nothing. They pile things up with no idea who'll get them.
So now, Lord, what am I waiting for? My hope is in you.
Rescue me from all my wrongdoing. Don't let fools make me their punch line.
I stayed quiet and didn't open my mouth, because you were the one who did it.
Take this punishment off me. The blow of your hand is more than I can bear.
When you correct people for their sin, you eat away what they treasure like a moth. We're all just a breath.” Selah.
“Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my cry. Don't stay silent when I'm in tears. I'm a stranger staying with you, a traveler like all my ancestors.
Please spare me so I can get my strength back before I go away and am gone for good.”
For the music director. A psalm by David. I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned toward me and heard my cry.
He pulled me out of a terrible pit, up out of the sticky mud. He set my feet on rock and gave me solid ground to stand on.
He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see it, stand in awe, and trust the LORD. 🎶
Blessed is anyone who puts their trust in the LORD and doesn't look up to the proud or follow people who turn to lies.
LORD my God, you've done so many wonderful things and thought of us in so many ways. I couldn't tell them all back to you. If I tried, there'd be more than I could count.
Sacrifices and offerings weren't what you wanted. You opened my ears. You didn't ask for a burnt offering or an offering for sin.
Then I said, “Look, I've come. In the scroll, it's written about me.
I love doing what you want, my God. Your law is right here in my heart.”
I've told the great gathering the good news of your righteousness. LORD, you know I'm not keeping my mouth shut.
I haven't kept your righteousness to myself. I spoke about your faithfulness and how you save. I didn't hide your faithful love or your truth from the great gathering.
LORD, don't hold back your tender mercy from me. Let your faithful love and your truth keep me safe always.
Trouble I can't even count has closed in around me. My wrongs caught up with me, and I can't lift my head. There are more of them than hairs on my head. My courage is gone.
LORD, please rescue me. LORD, come help me quick.
Let the people out to take my life end up ashamed and confused. Turn back and disgrace the people who enjoy seeing me hurt.
Let the shame of it leave them stunned, those who taunt me with, “Aha! Aha!”
Let everyone who seeks you celebrate and be glad in you. Let people who love the way you save keep saying, “Lift up the LORD!” 🙌
I'm poor and in need. May the Lord keep me in mind. You're my help and my rescuer. My God, don't wait.
For the music director. A psalm by David. Blessed is anyone who looks out for the poor. The LORD will rescue them when trouble hits.
The LORD will protect them and keep them alive. They'll be blessed in the land, and he won't hand them over to what their enemies want.
The LORD will hold them up on their sickbed and help them get back on their feet.
I said, “LORD, show me mercy! Heal me, because I've sinned against you.”
My enemies talk trash about me. “When will he die and his name disappear?”
If one comes to see me, he tells me lies and collects anything he can use against me. As soon as he leaves, he spreads it around.
Everyone who hates me gets together to whisper about me. They imagine the worst for me.
“Some awful disease has got him,” they say. “Now that he's down, he's never getting up.”
Even my close friend, the one I trusted and shared my bread with, turned against me.
But you, LORD, show me mercy and lift me back up so I can repay them.
I know you delight in me because my enemy doesn't get to celebrate a win over me.
You hold me up in my integrity and keep me in your presence forever.
Bless the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! Amen and amen. 🙌
For the music director. A psalm for reflection by the sons of Korah. Like a deer panting for streams of water, my soul longs for you, God.
I'm thirsty for God, for the living God. When can I come and stand before him?
My tears have been my food day and night, while people keep asking, “Where's your God?”
I remember how I used to walk with the crowd and lead them to God's house. We shouted with joy and praise, a whole crowd celebrating a holy day. I pour out my soul as I remember.
Why are you so down, my soul? Why are you so restless inside me? Put your hope in God! I'll praise him again for the help that comes from his presence.
My God, my soul is sinking. So I remember you from the land of the Jordan, from the heights of Hermon, and from Mount Mizar.
Deep calls to deep in the roar of your waterfalls. All your waves and breakers have swept over me. 🌊
By day the LORD sends his faithful love. At night his song stays with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
I'll ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go around grieving under my enemy's oppression?”
My enemies' insults cut like a sword in my bones. They keep asking, “Where's your God?”
Why are you so down, my soul? Why are you so restless inside me? Put your hope in God! I'll praise him again, my rescuer and my God.
God, show that I'm in the right. Take up my case against a nation that turns away from you. Rescue me from people who lie and do evil.
You're the God who gives me strength. Why have you turned me away? Why do I go around grieving under my enemy's oppression?
Send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me all the way to your holy hill, to your tents. ✨
Then I'll go to God's altar, to God, my greatest joy. I'll praise you on the harp, God, my God.
Why are you so down, my soul? Why are you so restless inside me? Put your hope in God! I'll praise him again, my Savior, my helper, and my God.
For the music director. A psalm for reflection by the sons of Korah. God, we've heard it with our own ears. Our ancestors told us what you did in their day, way back then.
You drove out nations with your own hand and planted our ancestors there. You brought trouble on those peoples and spread our ancestors through the land.
Their swords didn't win them the land. Their own strength didn't save them. It was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you looked on them with favor.
God, you're my King. Command victories for Jacob!
With your help we'll push back our enemies. In your name we'll trample those who rise against us.
I won't put my trust in my bow. My sword can't save me.
You saved us from our enemies and put those who hated us to shame.
We've boasted in God all day. We'll thank your name forever. Selah.
But now you've rejected us and left us in disgrace. You don't go out with our armies.
You make us retreat from the enemy. The people who hate us take what they want.
You've made us like sheep for food and scattered us among the nations.
You sold your people for practically nothing and made nothing from the sale.
You've made us a disgrace to our neighbors. Everyone around us scoffs and laughs at us.
You've made us a punch line among the nations. People shake their heads at us.
My disgrace is in front of me all day. Shame covers my face
when I hear their insults and taunts, when I face the enemy bent on revenge.
All this came down on us, and we still haven't forgotten you or betrayed your covenant.
Our hearts haven't turned away, and our feet haven't strayed from your path,
even though you crushed us where jackals live and covered us with the shadow of death.
If we'd forgotten our God's name or stretched out our hands to another god,
wouldn't God find out? He knows what's hidden in every heart.
For your sake we're killed all day long. People treat us like sheep headed for slaughter.
Wake up! Lord, why are you sleeping? Get up! Don't turn us away forever.
Why do you hide your face? Why forget how we're hurting and how they're oppressing us?
We're bowed down to the dust. Our bodies cling to the ground.
Get up and help us. Redeem us for the sake of your faithful love. 🙏

For the music director, to “The Lilies.” A psalm for reflection by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with something beautiful to say. I'm reciting my verses for the king. My tongue moves like a skilled writer's pen.
You stand out above everyone. Grace rests on your lips, and God has blessed you forever.
Strap your sword to your thigh, mighty one, in all your splendor and majesty.
Ride out in majesty and win the victory for truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand show what awesome things it can do.
Your arrows are sharp. Nations fall before you as your arrows pierce the hearts of the king's enemies.
Your throne, God, lasts forever and ever. The scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of justice.
You love righteousness and hate wickedness. That's why God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of joy above everyone beside you.
Your clothes carry the scent of myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Music from stringed instruments in ivory palaces brings you joy. 🎶
Daughters of kings are among your honored women. The queen stands at your right hand wearing gold from Ophir. 👑
Listen, daughter. Take this in and pay attention. Leave behind your own people and your father's house.
The king will be drawn to your beauty. Honor him, because he's your lord.
The daughter of Tyre will come with a gift. The wealthiest people will ask for your favor.
The princess is radiant inside the palace. Her clothes are woven with gold.
She'll be led to the king in embroidered clothes. Her young companions, the virgins who follow her, will be brought to you.
They'll be led in with joy and celebration. They'll enter the king's palace.
Your sons will take the place of your ancestors. You'll make them princes all across the earth.
I'll keep your name alive through every generation. That's why the peoples will thank you forever and ever.
For the music director. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our shelter and our strength. When trouble hits, he's right here to help.
So we won't be afraid, even if the earth shifts and the mountains tumble into the heart of the sea,
even if the waters roar and churn and the mountains shake as the waves rise. Selah.
There's a river whose streams bring joy to God's city, the holy place where the Most High pitches his tents.
God is in the city, so it won't be shaken. God will come to its aid at dawn.
Nations raged and kingdoms shook. He raised his voice, and the earth melted.
The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our shelter. Selah.
Come see what the LORD has done. Look at the devastation he's brought on the earth.
He puts an end to wars all the way to the ends of the earth. He snaps the bow, shatters the spear, and burns the chariots.
“Be still and know that I am God. I'll be exalted among the nations. I'll be exalted on the earth.” 🙏
The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our shelter. Selah.
For the music director. A psalm by the sons of Korah. Clap your hands, all you nations! Raise a victory shout to God! 👏
The LORD Most High is awesome. He's the great King over the whole earth.
He brings nations under our rule and puts peoples under our feet.
He picks out our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob, whom he loved. Selah.
God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the blast of a trumpet.
Sing praise to God! Sing praise! Sing praise to our King! Sing praise! 🎶
God is King over the whole earth. Sing praise with understanding.
God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
The rulers of the peoples gather as the people of Abraham's God. The shields of the earth belong to God. He is lifted high!
A song. A psalm by the sons of Korah. The LORD is great and deserves great praise in our God's city, on his holy mountain.
Mount Zion rises beautifully on the northern heights, the joy of the whole earth. It's the city of the great King.
God has shown that he's a safe place in the city's fortresses.
Look, the kings gathered and marched past together.
They saw the city and froze in amazement. Then panic hit, and they hurried away.
They started shaking right there, gripped by pain like a woman in labor.
With an east wind you smash the ships of Tarshish.
We'd heard about it, and now we've seen it ourselves in the city of the LORD of Armies, the city of our God. God will keep it standing forever. Selah.
God, we think about your faithful love right in the middle of your temple.
God, your praise reaches as far as your name, all the way to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion celebrate! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments. 🙌
Take a walk around Zion. Make the whole circuit and count its towers.
Look closely at its defenses and take in its palaces so you can tell the next generation.
This God is our God forever and ever. He'll guide us all the way to death.
For the music director. A psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples! Everyone in the world, listen up.
High or low, rich or poor, listen together.
I'll speak wisdom. What my heart has to say comes from understanding.
I'll listen closely to a proverb and work out my riddle on the harp.
Why should I be afraid when trouble hits and the wrong of those at my heels closes in around me?
People trust their money and flex about how much they have.
Yet none of them can buy back a brother's life or pay God a ransom for him.
A life costs too much to buy back. No payment could ever cover it
so someone could live forever and never see decay.
Anyone can see that wise people die. Fools and people with no sense die too. They all leave what they own to someone else.
Deep down they think their houses will last forever and their homes will stand for generations. They even name their lands after themselves.
For all their riches, people don't last. They die like the animals do.
That's where foolish people end up, along with everyone who buys into what they say. Selah.
They're headed for Sheol like sheep in a flock, with death as their shepherd. In the morning the upright will rule over them. Their beauty will decay in Sheol, far from the mansions they called home.
But God will buy my life back from the grip of Sheol. He'll take me in. Selah.
Don't be afraid when someone gets rich and their household grows more impressive.
When they die, they can't take a thing. Their glory won't go down with them.
Even if they congratulate themselves while they're alive, and people applaud them for doing well,
they'll join their ancestors, who will never see the light again.
Riches without understanding leave a person like the animals that die.
A psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks. He calls to the whole earth from sunrise to sunset.
God shines out from Zion, beauty in its fullness.
Our God is coming, and he isn't staying quiet. Fire devours everything ahead of him, and a wild storm surrounds him.
He calls to the heavens above and to the earth so he can judge his people.
“Gather my faithful people to me, the ones who made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”
The heavens will tell of his righteousness, because God himself is the judge. Selah.
“Listen, my people. I have something to say. Israel, I'll testify against you. I am God, your God.
I'm not calling you out over your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are always in front of me.
I don't need a bull from your stall or male goats from your pens.
Every animal in the forest is mine, and so are the cattle on a thousand hills.
I know every bird in the mountains. All the wild animals in the fields are mine.
Even if I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you. The world and everything in it belong to me.
Do I eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats?
Offer God your thanks as a sacrifice. Keep the promises you made to the Most High.
Call on me when trouble hits. I'll rescue you, and you'll honor me.”
But God says to the wicked, “What gives you the right to recite my rules or say the words of my covenant
when you hate being taught and toss my words behind you?
When you see a thief, you're on board. You join up with people who commit adultery.
You let your mouth run with evil. Your tongue works up lies.
You sit there talking against your own brother and spreading lies about your own mother's son.
You did all that while I stayed quiet. You figured I was just like you. I'll call you out and lay the charges right in front of you.
Think about this, you who forget God, before I tear you to pieces and there's nobody to rescue you.
Whoever offers thanks as a sacrifice honors me and gets their path ready for me to show them God's salvation.”

For the music director. A psalm by David, when the prophet Nathan came to him after David had slept with Bathsheba. God, show me mercy because of your faithful love. In your deep compassion, wipe away my wrongs.
Wash all the wrongdoing off me. Cleanse me from my sin.
I know what I've done. My sin is always right in front of me.
Against you, you alone, I've sinned and done what's evil in your sight. You're right when you speak and just when you judge.
I was born into wrongdoing. My mother conceived me in sin.
You want truth deep inside me. That's where you teach me wisdom.
Cleanse me with hyssop, and I'll be clean. Wash me, and I'll be whiter than snow.
Let me hear joy and gladness again. Let the bones you've broken celebrate.
Turn your face away from my sins and wipe out all my wrongdoing.
God, create a clean heart in me. Renew a right spirit inside me. 🙏
Don't cast me out of your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.
Give me back the joy of your salvation. Hold me up with a willing spirit.
Then I'll teach people who rebel how to walk in your ways, and sinners will turn back to you.
God who saves me, free me from the guilt of bloodshed. I'll sing out about your righteousness.
Lord, open my lips, and I'll speak your praise.
If a sacrifice were what you wanted, I'd give it. You take no pleasure in a burnt offering.
The sacrifice God wants is a broken spirit. God, you won't look down on a heart that's broken and sorry.
In your kindness, do good to Zion. Build up Jerusalem's walls.
Then you'll delight in sacrifices offered rightly, in burnt offerings and whole burnt offerings. Then they'll offer bulls on your altar.

For the music director. A psalm for reflection by David, when Doeg the Edomite told Saul, “David has gone to Ahimelech's house.” Why are you flexing about the harm you've done, mighty man? God's faithful love lasts all day long.
Your tongue plans destruction. It's like a sharp razor when you use it to deceive.
You love evil more than good. You'd rather lie than speak the truth. Selah.
You love every word that tears people apart, you lying tongue.
God will tear you down for good. He'll grab you, pull you out of your tent, and uproot you from the land of the living. Selah.
People who do right will see it, stand in awe, and laugh at him.
“Look at him. He didn't make God his strength. He counted on piles of money and built up his power by doing wrong.”
But I'm like a green olive tree in God's house. I'm trusting God's faithful love forever and ever. 🫒
I'll thank you forever for what you've done. I'll put my hope in your name, because it's good, right there with your faithful people.
For the music director, to “Mahalath.” A psalm for reflection by David. The fool thinks, “There's no God.” They're corrupt and have done awful things. No one does good.
God looks down from heaven at humanity to see if anyone understands and seeks him.
Every one of them has turned back. They've all become corrupt together. No one does good. Not even one.
Do these people doing wrong understand anything? They devour my people like they're eating bread, and they never call on God.
They were terrified where there was nothing to fear. God scattered the bones of those camped against you. You put them to shame because God rejected them.
If only rescue for Israel would come from Zion! When God brings his people back from captivity, Jacob will celebrate and Israel will be glad. 🙌
For the music director. On strings. A psalm for reflection by David, when the Ziphites told Saul, “Isn't David hiding among us?” God, save me by your name. Use your strength to show I'm in the right.
God, hear my prayer. Listen to what I'm saying.
Strangers have come after me. Violent people want me dead. They don't keep God in mind. Selah.
Look, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who keeps me going.
He'll pay back my enemies for the evil they've done. In your faithfulness, bring them down.
I'll gladly bring you a sacrifice. I'll thank your name, LORD, because it is good. 🙏
He's rescued me from every trouble. I've seen my enemies defeated with my own eyes.
For the music director. On strings. A psalm for reflection by David. God, listen to my prayer. Don't hide from me when I plead with you.
Pay attention to me and answer. I can't sit still with all this pain, and I groan
because of what my enemies say and how the wicked press in on me. They pile trouble on me and hold on to their anger against me.
My heart aches deep inside. The terror of death has come over me.
Fear has me shaking, and horror has swallowed me up.
I said, “If only I had wings like a dove! I'd fly away and finally get some rest.
I'd go far away and stay out in the wilderness.” Selah.
“I'd hurry to find shelter from the fierce wind and storm.”
Lord, throw them into confusion and scramble their words. I've seen violence and conflict in the city.
They prowl around on its walls day and night. Malice and abuse are all through the city.
Destruction is at work inside it. Threats and lies never leave its streets.
If an enemy had insulted me, I could've taken it. If someone who hated me had risen against me, I could've hidden from him.
But it was you, someone like me, my companion and my close friend.
We used to share good times together. We walked with the crowd into God's house.
Let death catch them by surprise. Let them go down alive into Sheol. Wickedness lives right there among them.
As for me, I'll call on God. The LORD will save me.
Evening, morning, and noon, I'll cry out in distress. He'll hear my voice.
He brought me safely out of the battle against me, even with so many people coming after me.
God, who's been on his throne forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They refuse to change and have no fear of God.
He raises his hands against his own friends. He broke his covenant.
His words were smooth as butter, but inside he was ready for war. His talk was softer than oil, yet every word was a drawn sword.
Put your burden on the LORD. He'll hold you up. He'll never let people who do right be shaken. 🙏
God, you'll bring them down into the pit of destruction. People who thirst for blood and live by deceit won't make it through half their days. I'll put my trust in you.

For the music director, to “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines grabbed him in Gath. Show me mercy, God. People want to swallow me whole. They come after me and press me down all day.
My enemies want to swallow me up all day long. So many of them come at me full of pride.
When I'm scared, I'll put my trust in you.
In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I won't be afraid. What can mere flesh do to me?
All day they twist my words. All they think about is how to hurt me.
They get together to plot and wait in hiding, watching my every step. They're out to take my life.
Will they get away with it by doing wrong? God, bring those peoples down in your anger.
You've counted every place I've wandered. You keep my tears in your bottle. Aren't they written in your book?
My enemies will turn back the day I call on you. I know God is for me.
In God, I'll praise his word. In the LORD, I'll praise his word.
I've put my trust in God. I won't be afraid. What can people do to me?
God, I owe you what I vowed. I'll bring you offerings of thanks.
You saved my life from death and kept my feet from falling, so I can walk before you in the light of the living. 🙏

For the music director, to “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul into the cave. Show me mercy, God. Show me mercy, because I run to you for shelter. I'll stay in the shadow of your wings until the disaster passes.
I cry out to God Most High, to the God who acts on my behalf.
He'll send help from heaven and save me. He'll rebuke the one chasing me. Selah. God will send his faithful love and his truth.
I'm surrounded by lions. I lie down among people burning with rage. Their teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongues are sharp swords.
God, rise high above the heavens! Let your glory be over the whole earth!
They set a net in my path, and my soul sank. They dug a pit in front of me and fell right into it themselves. Selah.
My heart is steady, God. My heart is steady. I'll sing and give you praise.
Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I'll wake up the dawn. 🎶
Lord, I'll thank you among the peoples. I'll sing your praise among the nations.
Your great faithful love reaches the heavens, and your truth reaches the skies.
God, rise high above the heavens! Let your glory be over the whole earth.
For the music director, to “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David. Do you silent ones really speak what's right? Do you people judge fairly?
No, you plan injustice in your hearts. You deal out violence with your own hands across the earth.
The wicked go off course from the womb. They start going astray and telling lies from birth.
Their venom is like a snake's, like a deaf cobra that shuts its ears
and won't listen to the charmers, no matter how good they are.
God, break the teeth in their mouths. LORD, smash the fangs of those young lions.
Let them drain away like running water. When they draw their bows, let their arrows lose their edge.
Let them disappear like a snail that melts away, like a stillborn child who never saw the sun.
Before your pots even feel the heat of the thorn fire, God will sweep away the green branches and the burning ones alike.
People who do right will rejoice when they see justice done. They'll wash their feet in the blood of the wicked,
and people will say, “Doing what's right really does have a reward. There really is a God who judges the earth.”

For the music director, to “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent people to watch the house and kill him. My God, rescue me from my enemies. Lift me out of reach of those who rise against me.
Get me away from people who do evil. Save me from people out for blood.
Look, they're lying in wait for my life. Powerful people are teaming up against me. LORD, this isn't because I rebelled or sinned.
I've done nothing wrong, and they're ready to come at me. Get up, see what's happening, and help me!
LORD God of Armies, God of Israel, rise up to call the nations to account. Show no mercy to wicked traitors. Selah.
They come back at night, howling like dogs and prowling around the city.
Listen to what they spew. Their words are swords. “Who's going to hear us?” they say.
But you laugh at them, LORD. You scoff at all the nations.
My Strength, I'm watching for you. God is my high tower.
My God will go ahead of me with his faithful love. He'll let me see my enemies defeated.
Don't kill them, or my people might forget. Scatter them with your power and bring them down, Lord, our shield.
Let their sinful words and the curses and lies they tell catch them in their own pride.
Consume them in your anger. Wipe them out completely. Let people know that God rules in Jacob, all the way to the ends of the earth. Selah.
Let them come back at night. Let them howl like dogs and circle the city.
They'll roam around for food and stay up all night if they can't get enough.
