Save us with your right hand and answer us, so the people you love can be rescued.
God spoke from his sanctuary: “I’ll celebrate in triumph. I’ll divide up Shechem and measure out the valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim is my helmet, and Judah is my scepter.
Moab is my washbasin. I’ll toss my sandal onto Edom and shout in triumph over Philistia.”
Who’ll bring me into the fortified city? Who’ll lead me to Edom?
Haven’t you rejected us, God? You aren’t going out with our armies.
Help us against the enemy, because human help gets us nowhere.
With God we’ll fight bravely. He’s the one who’ll trample our enemies.
For the lead musician. A psalm by David. God I praise, don’t go quiet on me.
Wicked, dishonest people have opened their mouths against me. They’ve told me lies to my face.
They’ve surrounded me with hateful words and come at me for no reason.
I gave them love, and they turned into my enemies. But I keep praying.
They’ve paid back my good with evil and my love with hate.
Put a wicked man over him. Let an accuser stand at his right hand.
When he’s judged, let him be found guilty. Let his prayer count as sin.
Let his days be few. Let someone else take his place.
Let his children lose their father and his wife become a widow.
Let his children wander about and beg. Let them be sought out from their ruined homes.
Let the man he owes take everything he’s got. Let strangers grab everything he worked for.
Let no one show him kindness or feel sorry for his fatherless children.
Let his family line be cut off. Let their name be erased in the next generation.
Let the LORD remember his ancestors’ wrongdoing. Don’t let his mother’s sin be wiped away.
Let those wrongs stay before the LORD, so he cuts off their memory from the earth.
He never thought to show kindness. Instead he went after poor and needy people, hunting the brokenhearted down to kill them.
He loved to curse, so the curse came back to him. He took no joy in blessing, so blessing stayed far away.
He put on cursing like an outfit. It soaked inside him like water, like oil seeping into his bones.
Let it be like clothes wrapped around him, like a belt he always wears.
Let this be what my enemies get from the LORD, the people who speak evil against my very life.
But you, GOD my Lord, act for me for your name’s sake. Your faithful love is good, so rescue me.
I’m poor and in need. My heart is wounded deep inside.
I’m fading like an evening shadow. I’m shaken off like a locust.
My knees are weak from fasting. My body’s gone thin and lost its fat.
I’ve become someone they make fun of. When they see me, they shake their heads.
Help me, LORD my God! Save me in line with your faithful love,
so they’ll know this is your hand at work and that you, LORD, did it.
They can curse, but you bless. When they rise up, they’ll be put to shame, but your servant will rejoice.
Let my enemies wear dishonor. Let them wrap themselves in their own shame like a robe.
I’ll thank the LORD out loud with everything I’ve got. I’ll praise him right in the middle of the crowd.
He’ll stand at the right hand of the needy to save them from people who pass judgment on their life.
A psalm by David. The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footrest for you.”
The LORD will send out your mighty scepter from Zion. Rule right there among your enemies.
Your people will freely offer themselves on the day you show your power, dressed in holy splendor. From the womb of the dawn comes the dew of your youth.
The LORD swore an oath, and he won’t take it back: “You’re a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
The Lord is at your right hand. On the day of his anger he’ll crush kings.
He’ll judge the nations and pile up dead bodies. He’ll crush the ruler of the whole earth.
He’ll drink from a stream on the way, and that’s why he’ll lift his head.
Praise the LORD! I’ll thank the LORD with my whole heart, among upright people gathered together and in the whole assembly.
The LORD’s works are great, and everyone who loves what he does takes time to think about them.
His work is full of honor and majesty. His righteousness lasts forever.
He’s made his wonders things people will remember. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
He’s given food to those who fear him. His covenant never slips his mind.
He showed his people how powerful his works are when he gave them the nations’ inheritance.
What he does with his hands is true and just. Every instruction he gives is reliable.
They’re set forever and ever, carried out in truth and uprightness.
He sent rescue to his people and established his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
Fearing the LORD is where wisdom starts. Everyone who follows his instructions has good sense. His praise goes on forever!
Praise the LORD! Blessed is the person who fears the LORD and finds real joy in his commands.
Their children will be mighty in the land. The generation of upright people will be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in their home. Their righteousness lasts forever.
Light breaks through the dark for upright people, for the gracious, merciful, and righteous.
Things go well for the person who is generous and lends. They handle their affairs with justice.
They won’t ever be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
They won’t panic over bad news. Their heart is steady because they trust the LORD.
Their heart is secure. They won’t be afraid when they finally look on their enemies.
They’ve spread what they have around and given to poor people. Their righteousness lasts forever. Their strength will be lifted up in honor.
The wicked will see it and get upset. They’ll grind their teeth and melt away. What the wicked long for will come to nothing.
Praise the LORD! You servants of the LORD, give him praise! Praise the LORD’s name.
Bless the LORD’s name from now on and forever.
From sunrise to sunset, the LORD’s name deserves praise.
The LORD is high above every nation. His glory is above the heavens.
Who’s like the LORD our God, who sits way up high
and stoops down to look at heaven and earth?
He lifts poor people out of the dirt and raises needy people from the ash heap,
so he can give them a seat with princes, right alongside the princes of his people.
He settles the woman who couldn’t have children in a home as a joyful mother. Praise the LORD!
When Israel came out of Egypt, when Jacob’s family left a people who spoke a foreign language,
Judah became God’s sanctuary, and Israel became his kingdom.
The sea saw it and ran. The Jordan turned back.
The mountains bounced like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
What made you run, sea? Jordan, what made you turn back?
Mountains, why did you bounce like rams? Little hills, why like lambs?
Earth, tremble before the Lord, before the God of Jacob,
who turned the rock into a pool and the hard flint into a spring of water.
Don’t give glory to us, LORD, don’t give it to us. Give it to your name, because of your faithful love and your truth.
Why should the nations get to say, “So where’s their God now?”
Our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he wants.
Their idols are silver and gold, made by human hands.
They’ve got mouths but can’t talk. They’ve got eyes but can’t see.
They’ve got ears but can’t hear. They’ve got noses but can’t smell.
They’ve got hands but can’t feel. They’ve got feet but can’t walk. Not a sound comes from their throats.
The people who make them will end up like them, and so will everyone who trusts them.
Israel, put your trust in the LORD! He’s their help and their shield.
Family of Aaron, put your trust in the LORD! He’s their help and their shield.
You who fear the LORD, put your trust in him! He’s their help and their shield.
The LORD remembers us and will bless us. He’ll bless the family of Israel and the family of Aaron.
He’ll bless those who fear him, the small and the great alike.
May the LORD make you grow in number, you and your children.
May you be blessed by the LORD, the one who made heaven and earth.
The heavens belong to the LORD, but he gave the earth to human beings.
Dead people don’t praise the LORD, and neither does anyone who goes down into silence.
But we’ll bless the LORD from now on and forever. Praise the LORD!
I love the LORD because he hears my voice when I cry for mercy.
He leaned in to listen to me, so I’ll call on him as long as I live.
Death’s ropes wrapped around me. The pains of Sheol grabbed hold of me. I found myself in trouble and grief.
Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, please save my life!”
The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is full of mercy.
The LORD watches over the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
You can rest again, my soul. The LORD has been so good to you.
You saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.
I’ll walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
I believed, so I said, “I’ve been through serious trouble.”
I spoke in a rush and said, “Everybody lies.”
What can I give the LORD for all the good he’s done for me?
I’ll lift up the cup of salvation and call on the LORD’s name.
I’ll keep my vows to the LORD, right there in front of all his people.
The death of the people set apart for him is precious in the LORD’s eyes.
LORD, I really am your servant. I’m your servant, the son of your servant girl. You’ve set me free from my chains.
I’ll bring you a sacrifice of thanks and call on the LORD’s name.
I’ll keep my vows to the LORD in front of all his people,
in the courtyards of the LORD’s house, right in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD, every nation! Give him praise, all you peoples!
His faithful love for us is great. The LORD’s faithfulness lasts forever. Praise the LORD!
Thank the LORD because he’s good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Let Israel say it now: his faithful love lasts forever.
Let the family of Aaron say it now: his faithful love lasts forever.
Let those who fear the LORD say it now: his faithful love lasts forever.
I was in trouble, so I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me and set me free.
The LORD is on my side. I won’t be scared. What can any human do to me?
The LORD is on my side, right there among the people who help me. So I’ll see victory over the people who hate me.
It’s better to run to the LORD for shelter than to put your trust in people.
It’s better to run to the LORD for shelter than to put your trust in rulers.
All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.
They surrounded me, yes, on every side. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
They swarmed around me like bees. They burned out like thorns on fire. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
You shoved me hard to knock me down, but the LORD helped me.
The LORD is my strength and my song. He’s become my rescue.
Listen to the cheers of joy and rescue in the tents of the righteous: “The LORD’s right hand has done mighty things!
The LORD’s right hand is lifted high! The LORD’s right hand has done mighty things!”
I’m going to live, not die, and tell what the LORD has done.
The LORD disciplined me hard, but he didn’t hand me over to death.
Open the gates of righteousness for me. I’ll go through them and thank the LORD.
This is the LORD’s gate. The righteous will go through it.
I’ll thank you because you answered me and became my rescue.
The stone the builders turned down has become the cornerstone.
The LORD did this, and it blows us away to see it.
This is the day the LORD has made. Let’s celebrate and be glad in it! 🙌
Please save us now, LORD! LORD, please make things go well for us now.
Blessed is the one who comes in the LORD’s name! We bless you from the LORD’s house.
The LORD is God, and he’s given us light. Tie the sacrifice with ropes, right up to the horns of the altar.
You’re my God, and I’ll thank you. You’re my God, and I’ll lift you high.
Thank the LORD because he’s good. His faithful love lasts forever.
ALEPH Blessed are people whose lives are blameless and who walk by the LORD’s law.
Blessed are people who keep his statutes and seek him with their whole heart.
They don’t do what’s wrong. They walk in his ways.
You gave us your instructions to follow all the way.
If only my steps stayed steady so I could keep your statutes!
Then I wouldn’t hang my head when I look at all your commands.
I’ll thank you with an honest heart as I learn your righteous rulings.
I’ll keep your statutes. Please don’t leave me altogether. BETH
How can a young person keep their path clean? By living by your word.
I’ve sought you with my whole heart. Don’t let me wander from your commands.
I’ve tucked your word away in my heart so I won’t sin against you.
Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.
I’ve said out loud all the rulings you spoke.
Following your testimonies has made me as glad as having every kind of wealth.
I’ll take time to think about your instructions and pay attention to how you lead.
I find joy in your statutes. I won’t forget your word. GIMEL
Be good to your servant, so I can live and keep your word.
Open my eyes so I can see the amazing things in your law.
I’m a stranger here on earth. Don’t hide your commands from me.
I’m always aching deep down to know your rulings.
You call out the arrogant, the cursed ones who wander from your commands.
Take away this ridicule and contempt, because I’ve kept your statutes.
Even when rulers sit together and talk trash about me, your servant will dwell on your statutes.
Your statutes are my joy. They give me advice. DALETH
I’m down in the dust. Give me life again as you promised!
I told you what I’ve done, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
Help me understand what your instructions mean, so I can think about your wonders.
Grief has worn me down inside. Make me strong again by your word.
Keep me off the road of lies. Give me your law as a gift of grace.
I’ve chosen the way of truth. I’ve put your rulings right in front of me.
I’m holding tight to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me end up ashamed.
I run down the path of your commands because you’ve set my heart free. HE
Lord, teach me how to live by your statutes. I’ll stick with them to the end.
Give me understanding, and I’ll keep your law with my whole heart.
Lead me down the path your commands lay out. That’s where I find joy.
Turn my heart toward your statutes instead of toward selfish gain.
Turn my eyes away from what’s worthless. Give me life in your ways.
Keep the promise you made to your servant, so people will honor you with awe.
Take away the disgrace I dread, because your rulings are good.
Look how much I want to follow your instructions! Give me life in your righteousness. VAV
LORD, let your faithful love reach me, and save me just as you said you would.
Then I’ll have an answer for the person insulting me, because I trust your word.
Don’t take the words of truth out of my mouth, because I’m putting my hope in your rulings.
I’ll follow your law continually, forever and ever.
I’ll walk free because I’ve gone looking for your instructions.
I’ll talk about your statutes in front of kings and won’t hang my head.
I’ll find joy in your commands because I love them.
I reach out for your commands, the ones I love, and think deeply about your statutes. ZAYIN
Remember what you said to your servant, because you gave me hope.
Here’s what keeps me going in my suffering: your word has given me life again.
Arrogant people come at me with nonstop mockery, but I don’t turn away from your law.
LORD, I remember your rulings from long ago, and that comforts me.
I’m outraged that wicked people walk away from your law.
Your statutes have become my songs in the place I’m staying.
At night, LORD, I remember your name, and I keep your law.
This is how I live: I keep your instructions. HETH
The LORD is my share. I promised to live by your words.
I came looking for your favor with my whole heart. Show me mercy as you promised.
I took a hard look at how I was living and turned my steps toward your statutes.
I’ll hurry to obey your commands. I won’t put it off.
The wicked tie me up with ropes, but I won’t forget your law.
At midnight I’ll get up to thank you for your righteous rulings.
I’m a friend to everyone who fears you and follows your instructions.
LORD, the earth is full of your faithful love. Teach me your statutes. TETH
LORD, you’ve treated your servant well, just as you said you would.
Teach me good judgment and give me knowledge, because I trust your commands.
Before I went through pain, I wandered off, but now I keep your word.
You’re good, and what you do is good. Teach me your statutes.
Proud people have smeared me with a lie, but I’ll keep your instructions with my whole heart.
Their hearts are thick and numb as fat, but your law brings me joy.
Going through pain turned out to be good for me because I got to learn your statutes.
The law you’ve spoken is worth more to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH
Your hands made me and shaped me. Give me understanding so I can learn your commands.
People who fear you will see me and be glad, because I’ve put my hope in your word.
LORD, I know your judgments are right. You’ve let me suffer in faithfulness.
Please let your faithful love comfort me, just as you promised your servant.
Let your tender mercy come to me so I can live, because your law is my joy.
Let the arrogant be put to shame for taking me down when I did nothing wrong. I’ll keep thinking about your instructions.
Let the people who fear you turn to me, the ones who know your statutes.
Let my heart be blameless when it comes to your decrees, so I won’t end up ashamed. KAPF
I’m worn out inside waiting for you to save me. Your word is what I’m hoping in.
My eyes are wearing out looking for your promise. I keep asking, “When will you comfort me?”
I’ve become like a wineskin shriveled up in the smoke, but I haven’t forgotten your statutes.
How many days do I have left, your servant? When will you judge the people coming after me?
Proud people dug pits to trap me, going against your law.
Every command you give is reliable. They’re coming after me for no reason. Help me!
They almost wiped me off the earth, but I didn’t give up on your instructions.
Keep me alive by your faithful love, so I can obey the statutes you’ve spoken. LAMEDH
LORD, your word is set in heaven forever.
You stay faithful through every generation. You set the earth in place, and there it stands.
Your rulings still stand today, because everything serves you.
If your law hadn’t brought me joy, I would’ve died in my suffering.
I’ll never forget your instructions, because through them you gave me life again.
I belong to you. Save me, because I’ve gone looking for your instructions.
The wicked lie in wait to destroy me, but I’ll keep thinking about your statutes.
I’ve seen that even what looks perfect has its limits, but your commands go beyond them all. MEM
How I love your law! I think about it all day.
Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, because your commands stay with me.
I understand more than all my teachers, because I keep your testimonies on my mind.
I understand more than people older than me because I’ve kept your instructions.
I’ve held my feet back from every wrong road so I can keep your word.
I haven’t turned away from your rulings, because you’ve taught me yourself.
Your promises taste so sweet to me, sweeter than honey in my mouth!
Your instructions give me understanding, so I hate every false way. NUN
Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light on my path.
I’ve sworn it, and I’ve made it firm: I’ll obey your righteous rulings.
I’m hurting badly. LORD, give me life again like you said you would.
Please accept what I freely offer with my mouth. LORD, teach me your rulings.
My life is always in my hands, but I still won’t forget your law.
Wicked people put a trap in my way, but I haven’t wandered from your instructions.
Your testimonies are mine to keep forever. They fill my heart with joy.
I’ve set my heart on following your statutes forever, all the way to the end. SAMEKH
I hate double-minded people, but I love your law.
You’re my hiding place and my shield. I put my hope in your word.
Get away from me, you who do evil, so I can keep my God’s commands.
Hold me up like you said you would, so I can live. Don’t let my hope put me to shame.
Keep me on my feet, and I’ll be safe. I’ll keep paying attention to your statutes.
You reject everyone who wanders from your statutes, because all their scheming gets them nowhere.
You throw out all the wicked on earth like scrap from melted metal. That’s why I love your testimonies.
I shake all over in fear of you. Your judgments make me tremble. AYIN
I’ve done what’s just and right. Don’t leave me at the mercy of people who oppress me.
Guarantee your servant’s well-being. Don’t let arrogant people push me around.
My eyes are wearing out looking for your rescue and the righteous word you spoke.
Treat your servant in line with your faithful love. Teach me your statutes.
I’m your servant. Give me understanding so I can know your testimonies.
LORD, it’s time to act. They’re breaking your law.
That’s why I love your commands more than gold, even pure gold.
I see that every instruction you give is right, and I hate every false way. PE
Your testimonies are amazing. That’s why I keep them with all my soul.
When your words open up, they give light. They help even the simple understand.
I opened my mouth and gasped, longing for your commands.
Turn to me and show me mercy, the way you always do for people who love your name.
Set my steps firmly in your word. Don’t let any wrongdoing rule over me.
Buy back my freedom from those who oppress me, so I can follow your instructions.
Let your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
Tears stream down my face because people won’t follow your law. TZADHE
You’re righteous, LORD. Your judgments are right.
You gave your statutes in righteousness. They’re completely trustworthy.
My passion wears me out because my enemies ignore your words.
Your promises have been tested through and through, and your servant loves them.
I’m small, and people look down on me. Still, I don’t forget your instructions.
Your righteousness lasts forever, and your law is truth.
Trouble and anguish have grabbed hold of me, but your commands give me joy.
Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding so I can live. QOPH
I’ve called out with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I’ll keep your statutes.
I’ve called out to you. Save me, and I’ll follow your statutes.
Before dawn I get up and cry for help. I’ve put my hope in your words.
My eyes stay open through the watches of the night so I can think deeply about your word.
Hear my voice in your faithful love. LORD, give me life again according to your rulings.
People who chase wickedness are getting close. They’re nowhere near your law.
You’re near, LORD, and every one of your commands is true.
I’ve known for a long time from your testimonies that you set them in place forever. RESH
Look at what I’m going through and rescue me, because I haven’t forgotten your law.
Take up my case and buy back my freedom! Give me life again as you promised.
The wicked are far from rescue because they don’t look for your statutes.
Your tender mercies are great, LORD. Give me life again according to your rulings.
I’ve got plenty of enemies and people coming after me, but I haven’t turned away from your testimonies.
I look at the faithless with disgust because they won’t keep your word.
See how much I love your instructions. LORD, give me life again in your faithful love.
All your words are true. Every righteous ruling you give lasts forever. SIN AND SHIN
Rulers have come after me for no reason, but it’s your words that fill my heart with awe.
Your word makes me as glad as someone who’s found a huge haul of treasure.
I can’t stand lies. I hate them. I love your law.
Seven times a day I praise you because your rulings are righteous.
People who love your law have deep peace. Nothing trips them up.
I’ve hoped for you to save me, LORD, and I’ve followed your commands.
I’ve kept your testimonies with my whole soul. I love them so much.
I’ve followed your instructions and your testimonies. Every path I take is right in front of you. TAV
Let my cry reach you, LORD. Give me understanding, just as you said.
Let my plea reach you. Rescue me as you promised.
Let praise spill from my lips because you teach me your statutes.
Let me sing about your word, because all your commands are right.
Have your hand ready to help me, because I’ve chosen to follow your instructions.
I’ve longed for you to save me, LORD. Your law is my joy.
Let me live so I can praise you. Let your rulings help me.
I’ve wandered off like a lost sheep. Come look for your servant, because I haven’t forgotten your commands.
A song of ascents. When I was in trouble, I cried out to the LORD, and he answered me.
LORD, rescue me from lying lips and a tongue that tricks people.
What are you going to get for this? What more will be done to you, you lying tongue?
Sharp arrows from a mighty warrior, along with glowing coals from a juniper.
How miserable for me to live in Meshech, to stay among the tents of Kedar!
I’ve lived too long beside people who hate peace.
I’m all for peace, but the minute I speak up, they’re ready for war.
A song of ascents. I lift my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
He won’t let your foot slip. The one who watches over you won’t doze off.
Look, the one who watches over Israel won’t doze off or go to sleep.
The LORD is the one who watches over you. The LORD is your shade at your right hand.
The sun won’t hurt you in the daytime, and the moon won’t hurt you at night.
The LORD will guard you from all evil. He’ll guard your very life.
The LORD will watch over you when you go out and when you come back, from now on and forever.
A song of ascents. By David. I was so glad when they said, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”
Jerusalem, our feet are standing right inside your gates!
Jerusalem is built as a city held tightly together.
The tribes go up there, the LORD’s own tribes, to thank the LORD’s name, as Israel was told to do.
That’s where the thrones for judgment stand, the thrones of David’s family.
Pray for Jerusalem to have peace. May everyone who loves you do well.
May there be peace inside your walls and well-being inside your palaces.
For my brothers and friends, I’ll say it now: “May there be peace inside you.”
For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I’ll look out for what’s good for you.
A song of ascents. I lift my eyes to you, the one seated in the heavens.
Just as servants watch their master’s hand and a servant girl watches her mistress’s hand, we keep our eyes on the LORD our God until he shows us mercy.
Show us mercy, LORD, show us mercy. We’ve taken more than enough contempt.
We’re filled to the brim with the mocking of people who have it easy and the contempt of the proud.
A song of ascents. By David. If the LORD hadn’t been on our side, let Israel say it now,
if the LORD hadn’t been on our side when people rose up against us,
they would’ve swallowed us alive when their anger flared up at us.
The waters would’ve overwhelmed us, and the current would’ve swept over our lives.
Those proud waters would’ve swept right over us.
Bless the LORD, who didn’t hand us over as prey for their teeth.
We got away like a bird from a hunter’s trap. The trap broke, and we got free.
Our help is in the name of the LORD, the one who made heaven and earth.
A song of ascents. People who trust the LORD are like Mount Zion. It can’t be moved, and it lasts forever.
Just like mountains surround Jerusalem, the LORD surrounds his people from now on and forever.
The rule of the wicked won’t stay over the land given to the righteous, so the righteous won’t turn their own hands to evil.
LORD, be good to the people who do good and whose hearts are upright.
But as for people who turn off onto crooked roads, the LORD will lead them away with those who do wrong. Peace be on Israel.
A song of ascents. When the LORD brought people back to Zion, it felt like we were dreaming.
Our mouths filled with laughter, and our tongues with singing. The nations said, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
The LORD has done great things for us, and we’re glad!
LORD, restore what we’ve lost, like streams flowing again in the Negev.
The people who plant in tears will harvest in joy.
The one who heads out crying with seed to plant will come back celebrating, carrying bundles of grain.
A song of ascents. By Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, the builders work for nothing. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the guard stays up for nothing.
There’s no point in getting up early and staying up late just to eat bread you wore yourself out for. God gives sleep to the people he loves.
Look, children are an inheritance from the LORD. Children born to you are his reward.
Children born when you’re young are like arrows in a warrior’s hand.
Happy is the parent with a quiver full of them. They won’t hang their heads when they speak to their enemies at the gate.
A song of ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD and walks in his ways.
You’ll eat what your own hands worked for. You’ll be glad, and things will go well for you.
Your wife will be like a vine full of fruit deep inside your home, and your children like olive shoots all around your table.
Look, that’s how the one who fears the LORD is blessed.
May the LORD bless you from Zion, and may you see Jerusalem doing well all your life.
May you get to see your children’s children. Peace be on Israel.
A song of ascents. “They’ve made me suffer again and again since I was young.” Let Israel say it now:
“They’ve made me suffer again and again since I was young, but they didn’t beat me.”
Plowers ran their plows over my back and dragged their furrows long.
The LORD is righteous. He cut the ropes of the wicked apart.
Let everyone who hates Zion be put to shame and forced to turn back.
Let them be like grass on rooftops, drying out before it even grows up,
so harvesters can’t fill their hands with it and people tying bundles can’t fill their arms.
And nobody walking by says, “The LORD’s blessing be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”
A song of ascents. LORD, I’ve cried out to you from the depths.
Lord, hear my voice. Listen closely when I beg you for help.
LORD, if you kept track of every sin, Lord, who could stand?
But you have forgiveness, and that’s why people fear you.
I wait for the LORD. Everything in me waits. I put my hope in his word.
I want the Lord more than night guards want the morning, more than night guards want the morning.
Israel, put your hope in the LORD. He’s full of faithful love, and he has more than enough power to redeem.
He’ll redeem Israel from all their sins.
A song of ascents. By David. LORD, my heart isn’t proud, and I don’t look down on people. I don’t take on matters too big or too wonderful for me.
I’ve settled and quieted my soul. Like a weaned child resting with its mother, that’s how my soul rests inside me.
Israel, put your hope in the LORD, from now on and forever.
A song of ascents. LORD, remember David and all the hardship he went through.
Remember how he swore to the LORD and made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:
“I won’t go inside my house or climb into my bed.
I won’t let my eyes close in sleep or even let my eyelids doze
until I find a place for the LORD, a home for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
Look, we heard about it in Ephrathah and found it in the fields of Jaar.
“Let’s go into his home. Let’s worship at his footstool.”
Rise up, LORD, and go into your resting place, you and the ark of your strength.
Let your priests wear righteousness like clothing. Let your holy people shout with joy!
For the sake of David your servant, don’t turn your anointed one away.
The LORD swore David a true oath. He won’t take it back: “I’ll put one of your own children on your throne.
If your children keep my covenant and the testimony I teach them, their children will sit on your throne forever too.”
The LORD chose Zion. He wanted to make it his home.
“This is my resting place forever. I’ll live here, because this is where I want to be.
I’ll give her plenty of supplies and fill her poor with bread.
I’ll dress her priests in salvation, and her holy people will shout for joy.
There I’ll make David’s horn grow strong. I’ve set up a lamp for my anointed one.
I’ll dress his enemies in shame, but the crown on his own head will shine.”
A song of ascents. By David. Look how good it is, how good it feels, when brothers live together in unity!
It’s like precious oil poured on the head, running down the beard, down Aaron’s beard, all the way to the edge of his robes.
It’s like dew from Hermon settling on Zion’s hills. That’s where the LORD gives his blessing, life forever.
A song of ascents. Come on, praise the LORD, you servants of the LORD who stand in his house at night!
Lift your hands in the sanctuary and praise the LORD!
May the LORD bless you from Zion, the same LORD who made heaven and earth.
Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courtyards of our God’s house.
Praise the LORD because he’s good. Sing praises to his name because it’s a joy to do it.
The LORD chose Jacob for himself, Israel as his own special possession.
I know the LORD is great. Our Lord is above all gods.
Whatever the LORD wanted to do, he did, in heaven, on earth, in the seas, and in all the depths.
He raises clouds from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning flash with the rain. He brings wind out of his storehouses.
He struck down Egypt’s firstborn, both people and animals.
Egypt, he sent signs and wonders right into the middle of you, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
He struck many nations and killed powerful kings:
Sihon, king of the Amorites, Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
He gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel, his people.
LORD, your name lasts forever. Your fame goes on through every generation.
The LORD will judge his people and show compassion to his servants.
The nations’ idols are silver and gold, made by human hands.
They’ve got mouths but can’t speak. They’ve got eyes but can’t see.
They’ve got ears but can’t hear. There isn’t even a breath in their mouths.
The people who make them will end up like them, and so will everybody who trusts them.
Family of Israel, praise the LORD! Family of Aaron, praise the LORD!
Family of Levi, praise the LORD! Everyone who fears the LORD, praise the LORD!
Bless the LORD from Zion, the one who lives in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
Thank the LORD because he’s good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the God of gods. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the Lord of lords. His faithful love lasts forever.
He alone does great wonders. His faithful love lasts forever.
He made the heavens with understanding. His faithful love lasts forever.
He spread the earth out above the waters. His faithful love lasts forever.
He made the great lights. His faithful love lasts forever.
He made the sun to rule the day. His faithful love lasts forever.
He made the moon and stars to rule the night. His faithful love lasts forever.
He struck down Egypt’s firstborn. His faithful love lasts forever.
He brought Israel out from among them. His faithful love lasts forever.
He did it with a strong hand and an arm stretched out. His faithful love lasts forever.
He split the Red Sea in two. His faithful love lasts forever.
He led Israel straight through the middle of it. His faithful love lasts forever.
He swept Pharaoh and his army away in the Red Sea. His faithful love lasts forever.
He led his people through the wilderness. His faithful love lasts forever.
He struck down great kings. His faithful love lasts forever.
He killed mighty kings. His faithful love lasts forever.
He struck down Sihon, king of the Amorites. His faithful love lasts forever.
He struck down Og, king of Bashan. His faithful love lasts forever.
He gave their land as an inheritance. His faithful love lasts forever.
He made it the inheritance of Israel his servant. His faithful love lasts forever.
He remembered us when we were brought low. His faithful love lasts forever.
He rescued us from our enemies. His faithful love lasts forever.
He gives food to every living creature. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the God of heaven! His faithful love lasts forever.
We sat down beside Babylon’s rivers. We cried when we remembered Zion.
We hung up our harps on the willows there.
That’s where our captors asked us to sing. The people who tormented us demanded happy songs: “Sing us one of Zion’s songs!”
How are we supposed to sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand forget how to play.
Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if Jerusalem isn’t above all my other joys.
LORD, remember what Edom’s children did on Jerusalem’s day. They yelled, “Tear it down! Tear it all the way down to its foundation!”
Daughter of Babylon, you’re headed for destruction. Happy is the one who pays you back for what you did to us.
Happy is the one who takes your little ones and smashes them against the rock.
By David. I’ll thank you with my whole heart. Right in front of the gods I’ll sing your praise.
I’ll bow toward your holy temple and thank your name for your faithful love and truth, because you’ve lifted your name and your word above everything.
When I called, you answered me that very day. You gave me courage and made me strong inside.
LORD, every king on earth will thank you because they’ve heard the words you spoke.
They’ll sing about the LORD’s ways, because the LORD’s glory is great!
The LORD is high up, yet he looks after those who are low. He knows the proud from far away.
Even if I walk right through trouble, you’ll give me life again. You’ll stretch out your hand against my enemies’ anger, and your right hand will save me.
The LORD will finish what concerns me. LORD, your faithful love lasts forever. Don’t walk away from what your own hands have made.
For the lead musician. A psalm by David. LORD, you’ve searched me all the way through, and you know me.
You know when I sit down and when I get up. You understand my thoughts from far away.
You know the road I take and where I lie down. Every way I live is familiar to you.
Before I even get a word out, LORD, you already know the whole thing.
You surround me front and back and put your hand on me.
Knowing that blows my mind. It’s too high for me to reach.
Where could I go to get away from your Spirit? Where could I run from your presence?
If I go up to heaven, you’re there. If I make my bed in Sheol, there you are too!
If I ride out on the wings of the dawn and settle at the farthest edge of the sea,
even there your hand will lead me and your right hand will hold me.
If I say, “Surely the darkness will swallow me, and the light around me will turn to night,”
even darkness can’t hide from you. Night shines like day, because darkness is like light to you.
You formed the deepest parts of me. You knitted me together in my mother’s womb.
I thank you because you made me in a way that fills me with awe. What you do is wonderful, and I know that deep down.
My frame wasn’t hidden from you when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
You saw my body. All the days set for me were written in your book before even one of them had come.
How precious your thoughts are to me, God! There are so many of them!
If I tried counting them, there’d be more than grains of sand. When I wake up, I’m still with you.
If only you’d put the wicked to death, God. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty people!
They speak against you with evil intent. Your enemies misuse your name.
LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Don’t I grieve over those who rise against you?
I hate them completely. They’ve become my enemies.
Search me, God, and know what’s in my heart. Test me and know my thoughts.
See if there’s any wicked path in me, and lead me down the way that lasts forever.
For the lead musician. A psalm by David. LORD, rescue me from evil people. Keep me safe from violent people,
the ones who plot trouble in their hearts and keep getting together for war.
They sharpen their tongues like snakes. Viper venom is tucked under their lips. Selah.
LORD, keep me out of the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from violent people who’ve set out to trip me up.
Proud people have hidden a trap for me. They’ve laid the ropes of a net beside my path. They’ve set snares for me. Selah.
I told the LORD, “You’re my God.” LORD, listen to me crying out for help.
GOD my Lord, you’re the strength that saves me. You covered my head on the day of battle.
LORD, don’t give the wicked what they want. Don’t let their evil plans work, or they’ll get proud. Selah.
As for the people surrounding me, let the trouble their own lips started come down on their heads.
Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into muddy pits they can’t climb out of.
People who speak evil won’t get established on earth. Evil will hunt down violent people and bring them down.
I know the LORD will take up the case of people who are suffering and get justice for those in need.
The righteous will thank your name. Upright people will live in your presence.
A psalm by David. LORD, I’m calling on you. Come quickly! Hear my voice when I call.
Let my prayer reach you like incense, and my raised hands be like the evening sacrifice.
LORD, set a guard over my mouth. Watch the door of my lips.
Don’t let my heart lean toward anything evil, or let me join people who do wrong in their wicked deeds. Don’t let me eat their fancy food.
Let someone righteous strike me. That’s an act of kindness. Let them correct me. That’s like oil on my head, and I won’t refuse it. Still, I’ll keep praying against evil deeds.
Their judges are thrown down along the rock. They’ll hear my words, because those words are well spoken.
“Like soil broken up by a plow, our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
My eyes are on you, GOD my Lord. You’re where I run for shelter. Don’t leave my life stripped of everything.
Keep me out of the snare they’ve set for me and away from the traps of people who do wrong.
Let the wicked all fall into their own nets while I walk right past.
A reflection by David from when he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry out loud to the LORD. I ask the LORD out loud for mercy.
I pour out my complaint in front of him and tell him all my trouble.
When my spirit was overwhelmed inside me, you knew the path I was on. On the path I walk, they’ve hidden a trap for me.
Look to my right and see. There’s nobody looking out for me. I’ve got nowhere to run, and no one cares whether I live.
I cried out to you, LORD. I said, “You’re my shelter, my share in the land of the living.”
Listen to my cry because I’m desperate. Save me from those coming after me, because they’re too strong for me.
Get my soul out of prison so I can thank your name. Righteous people will gather around me, because you’ll be good to me.
A psalm by David. LORD, hear my prayer. Listen when I ask you for help. Answer me in your faithfulness and righteousness.
Don’t bring your servant into judgment, because no one alive is righteous in your eyes.
My enemy is chasing me down. He’s knocked my life to the ground and made me live in dark places like somebody long dead.
That’s why my spirit is overwhelmed inside me. My heart feels empty and ruined.
I remember the old days. I think about everything you’ve done. I reflect on what your hands have made.
I reach out my hands to you. My soul is thirsty for you like cracked, dry soil. Selah.
Hurry and answer me, LORD. My spirit’s giving out. Don’t hide your face so I end up like the people who go down into the pit.
Let me hear about your faithful love in the morning, because I trust you. Show me which way to walk, because I lift my soul to you.
LORD, save me from my enemies. I run to you to hide me.
Teach me to do what you want, because you’re my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land where people do what’s right.
LORD, give me life again for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, get me out of trouble.
In your faithful love, cut off my enemies and destroy everyone who brings trouble on my soul, because I’m your servant.
By David. Bless the LORD, my rock. He trains my hands for war and my fingers for battle.
He’s my faithful love, my fortress, my high tower, my rescuer, my shield, and the one I run to for shelter. He brings my people under my rule.
LORD, what’s a human being that you care about them? What’s a human child that you even think of them?
Human beings are like a breath. Their days pass like a shadow.
Open up your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains so they smoke.
Send out lightning and scatter them. Shoot your arrows and throw them into confusion.
Reach down from above and rescue me. Pull me out of deep waters and out of the hands of foreigners,
whose mouths tell lies and whose right hands are raised to make false promises.
God, I’ll sing you a new song. I’ll sing your praises on a ten-string lyre.
You give victory to kings and rescue your servant David from the deadly sword.
Rescue me from the hands of foreigners whose mouths tell lies and whose right hands are raised to make false promises.
Then our sons will be like plants raised with care, and our daughters like pillars carved for a palace.
Our barns will be packed with every kind of supply, and our flocks will grow by the thousands and tens of thousands in our fields.
Our oxen will pull heavy loads. No one will break in or be taken away, and no cries of distress will fill our streets.
Happy are people who get to live like that. Happy are people whose God is the LORD.
A praise psalm by David. I’ll lift you high, my God and King. I’ll praise your name forever and ever.
I’ll praise you every day. I’ll lift up your name forever and ever.
The LORD is great and deserves great praise! There’s no getting to the bottom of his greatness.
One generation will tell the next about your works and speak of the mighty things you’ve done.
I’ll think deeply about your glorious majesty and honor and the wonders you’ve done.
People will talk about the power behind your awesome acts, and I’ll tell them how great you are.
They’ll tell the stories of your great goodness and sing about your righteousness.
The LORD is gracious and merciful, slow to get angry and full of faithful love.
The LORD is good to everyone. His tender mercy covers everything he’s made.
Everything you’ve made will thank you, LORD. Your holy people will lift you high.
They’ll talk about your kingdom’s glory and tell people about your power,
so everyone will know the mighty things you’ve done and the glorious majesty of your kingdom.
Your kingdom lasts forever. Your rule lasts through every generation. The LORD is faithful in everything he says and loving in everything he does.
The LORD holds up everyone who falls and lifts up everyone bowed down.
All eyes look to you and wait. You give them their food at the right time.
You open your hand and satisfy what every living thing needs.
The LORD is righteous in every way and gracious in everything he does.
The LORD is close to everyone who calls on him, everyone who calls on him in truth.
He’ll fulfill what the people who fear him long for. He’ll hear them cry out and save them.
The LORD watches over everyone who loves him, but he’ll destroy all the wicked.
I’ll praise the LORD out loud. Let every living person bless his holy name forever and ever.
Praise the LORD! My soul, praise the LORD!
I’ll praise the LORD my whole life. I’ll sing praises to my God as long as I’m here.
Don’t put your trust in rulers or in any mortal who can’t save you.
Their spirit leaves them, and back to the earth they go. That very day, their plans die with them.
Happy is the person whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD their God,
the one who made heaven and earth and the sea with everything in them, the one who stays true forever,
who brings justice to people held down and gives food to hungry people. The LORD sets prisoners free.
The LORD opens blind eyes. The LORD lifts people bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.
The LORD guards foreigners. He helps the fatherless and the widow but flips the road of the wicked upside down.
The LORD will reign forever. Zion, your God reigns through every generation. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! Singing to our God is good. Praising him feels right and good.
The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He brings Israel’s scattered people together.
He heals broken hearts and wraps up their wounds.
He counts every star and calls each one by name. ✨
Our Lord is great and mighty in power. There’s no limit to what he understands.
The LORD gives the humble a hand and brings the wicked down to the ground.
Sing to the LORD with thanks. Play the harp and sing praises to our God,
the one who covers the sky with clouds, gets rain ready for the earth, and makes grass grow on mountains.
He feeds the animals, even the young ravens when they call.
It isn’t a horse’s strength that delights him, and he takes no pleasure in human legs.
The LORD takes joy in people who fear him and put their hope in his faithful love.
Jerusalem, praise the LORD! Zion, praise your God!
He’s made the bars on your gates strong and blessed the children inside your walls.
He brings peace to your borders and fills you with the finest wheat.
He sends his command to earth. His word runs fast.
He sends snow like wool and scatters frost like ashes.
He throws down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand up to his cold?
He sends his word, and it all melts. He makes his wind blow, and the water flows.
He shows Jacob his word, and Israel his statutes and his judgments.
He hasn’t done that for any other nation. They don’t know his judgments. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! Praise him from the heavens! Praise him from way up high!
Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his heavenly armies!
Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, every shining star!
Praise him, highest heavens, and you waters above the heavens.
Let them praise the LORD’s name, because he gave the command and they came to be.
He set them in place forever and ever. He gave an order that won’t fade away.
Praise the LORD from earth, you great sea creatures and every depth of the ocean,
you lightning and hail, snow and clouds, and storm winds carrying out his word,
you mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
you wild animals and livestock, little creatures and birds in flight,
you kings of the earth and all peoples, you rulers and judges of the earth,
you young men and women, old people and children too.
Let them all praise the LORD’s name, because his name alone is lifted high. His glory is above earth and heaven.
He’s lifted up the horn of his people, praise for all his holy ones, for Israel’s children, the people close to him. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! Sing the LORD a new song, and sing his praise where his holy people gather.
Let Israel celebrate the one who made them. Let Zion’s children find joy in their King.
Let them dance to praise his name! Let them sing his praises with tambourine and harp!
The LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with rescue.
Let his holy people celebrate in honor. Let them sing for joy even on their beds.
Let praise for God ring from their mouths, with a double-edged sword in their hands,
to carry out vengeance on nations and punishment on peoples,
to chain their kings and bind their nobles with iron shackles,
to carry out the judgment written against them. This honor belongs to all his holy people. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his mighty heavens for the powerful things he’s done!
Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him the way his unmatched greatness deserves!
Praise him with a trumpet blast! Praise him with harp and lyre!
Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with strings and flute!
Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with cymbals that ring out!
Everything that breathes, praise the LORD! Praise the LORD! 🙌
